title: QA/RA Engineer – Medical Devices (MDR)
description:
Copenhagen area, Denmark (Industrivej 12, 3540 Lynge). Hybrid: remote work with on-site visits to Valcon typically once or twice a month. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU are welcome to apply. Application deadline: 30 October 2026. We are hiring as soon as possible, so applications are reviewed as received and the posting may close earlier once the position is filled.

Do you have solid experience with quality assurance and regulatory affairs for medical devices under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and are you motivated by the opportunity to build a QA/RA function from the ground up?

Would you like to take ownership of technical documentation, risk management, and Notified Body compliance for a growing medical device portfolio?

Then you might be our new QA/RA Engineer.

About Valcon Medical

Valcon Medical A/S manufactures medical cannabis extracts and cannabis oils for the Danish market and a number of export markets. We are approved by the Danish Medicines Agency to manufacture medical cannabis in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable Danish legislation on medical cannabis.

We are a company in development, with new products, processes, and technologies entering the organization, including an expanding medical device portfolio. This role is being established to build our QA/RA function for compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and to ensure our device documentation and processes meet Notified Body and Competent Authority expectations.

You will work closely with colleagues across Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs. As a smaller company, we have short decision-making paths, and the QA/RA function works closely with the rest of the organization. You will therefore have the opportunity to work with both classic QA/RA tasks and take responsibility for new issues, where you will independently investigate, assess, and help find the right solution, including shaping how our MDR compliance function is built from an early stage.

Areas of responsibility for the QA/RA function

  • Implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745

  • Maintain current knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485:2016, and relevant harmonised standards, and advise the organization on compliance matters

  • Preparation and maintenance of Technical Documentation (MDR Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist (Annex I) traceability to design and verification/validation evidence

  • Document Control as a core, ongoing function: creation, revision, review/approval routing, distribution, and archival of controlled documents and records (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.2.4/4.2.5)

  • Change Control: assessment and impact evaluation across design, risk, and regulatory documentation, and approval routing for design, process, and document changes

  • Risk management (ISO 14971) throughout the product lifecycle, including FMEA documentation and risk control/mitigation measures

  • Review and approval of verification and validation protocols and reports, and support for validation of processes, software, and equipment (e.g. IEC 62304, as applicable to the product)

  • Preparation and review of CAPAs and nonconformance reports

  • Supplier qualification and ongoing oversight of critical suppliers, including Quality Assurance Agreements (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.1.5 and 7.4)

  • Conduct supplier audits and support Notified Body audits under the MDR Annex IX conformity assessment procedure

  • Post-Market Surveillance per MDR Articles 83–86, including complaint handling, PMS reporting, and PMCF as applicable

  • Vigilance reporting to Competent Authorities per MDR Articles 87–92, including serious incident reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions

  • UDI assignment and EUDAMED registration activities (Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device and certificate registration)

  • Clinical Evaluation Report maintenance per MDR Article 61 / Annex XIV, in coordination with Clinical Affairs, where applicable

  • Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs to embed GSPR (Annex I) and Design Control (ISO 13485:2016 Clause 7.3) requirements into product development and production

  • Provide training to employees on QMS requirements, EU MDR obligations, and risk-management practices

  • Provide input on EU regulatory submissions and CE-marking compliance strategy, including engagement with Notified Bodies

Your qualifications and experience

We envision that you have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

  • A minimum of 2–5 years of experience in QA/RA roles within the medical device industry, working under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016

  • Hands-on working experience inside a live, certified ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System, not solely academic or classroom knowledge of the standard

  • Direct, hands-on experience operating within core QMS processes: Supplier Control, Document Control, Change Control, Complaint Handling, and CAPA

  • Working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745, and of relevant harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304 as applicable to the product)

  • Demonstrated, hands-on authorship or maintenance experience with EU MDR Technical Documentation (Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist mapping and design/verification/validation evidence linkage. General familiarity with the standard is not sufficient

  • Ability to interpret and apply EU regulatory requirements effectively, including direct engagement with Notified Bodies

  • Fluent English, written and spoken, for Notified Body and international supplier communication

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience with one or more of the following areas:

  • EUDAMED, the UDI system, and Basic UDI-DI concepts

  • EU GMP requirements, given Valcon's GMP-regulated production environment

  • Danish language skills

Your competencies

  • Works in a structured and systematic manner, with a focus on completing tasks

  • Able to work independently, take responsibility for own tasks, and drive projects forward

  • Strong grasp of risk management (ISO 14971) and verification/validation principles

  • Enjoys a mix of technical assessment, practical problem-solving, and documentation work

  • Is proactive, solution-oriented, and contributes positively to collaboration with colleagues

  • Competencies in data processing and report writing

What we offer

You will have a broad and independent role in a company in development, where you will help build our medical device QA/RA function from an early stage and work closely with production, product development, and the company's other activities.

As part of a smaller organization, you will have short decision-making paths, extensive insight across the company, and the opportunity to have real influence on both your own areas of responsibility and the development of our QA/RA function.

For the right person, there are good opportunities to develop the role as the company grows and to take responsibility for new subject areas and projects.

This is a hybrid role. Most of the work can be done remotely, and we expect you on site at our facility in Lynge, north of Copenhagen, typically once or twice a month. Expect more frequent presence during onboarding and around Notified Body and supplier audits. [Travel costs to Valcon are covered by the company.]

How to apply

The position is based in our QA/RA function. If you would like to hear more about the job, please contact Chanel La (cl@valcon-medical.com)

Please send your CV to job@valcon-medical.com. In your application, please include 3–4 sentences on a Technical Documentation or CAPA process you personally owned under a certified ISO 13485 QMS: what you did and what the outcome was.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN? - ARE YOU READY TO JOIN THE JOURNEY?
description:
SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN?

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent med ambitioner

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som både er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig.

Måske har du mange års erfaring med rengøring. Måske har du arbejdet i private hjem, hos erhvervskunder, med kvalitetssikring eller koordinering. Eller måske ved du bare, at du kan mere, end du får mulighed for at vise i dit nuværende job.

Så kan RenTid være stedet for dig.

⚠️ EN VIGTIG TING, DU SKAL VIDE

Hos RenTid starter alle på gulvet.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent – ikke som leder, supervisor eller direktør.

Du starter sammen med alle andre, ude hos kunderne og med rengøringen i hænderne.

Vi er ikke så optagede af din titel eller hvad der står på dit CV. Vi vil se:

  • Hvad du kan

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Din indstilling og arbejdsmoral

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder og kollegaer

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har det, der skal til for at vokse med RenTid

HVOR KAN DET FØRE DIG HEN?

Det ved vi ikke på forhånd. Det afhænger af dig.

Når RenTid vokser, opstår nye muligheder. Den rigtige medarbejder kan derfor med tiden få mere ansvar, eksempelvis:

  • Ansvar for bestemte kunder

  • Kvalitetskontrol

  • Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

  • Koordinering af kollegaer

  • Planlægning af opgaver

  • Kundekontakt

  • Ansvar for bestemte områder

  • Teamlederfunktioner

  • Driftsansvar

  • På længere sigt endnu større ansvar i virksomheden

Mulighederne er mange, hvis du viser, at du er klar til dem.

Vi vil gerne finde en person, som på sigt kan blive en central del af RenTid. Men større ansvar, højere løn og flere goder følger med det, du viser, du kan løfte.

DU STARTER MED EN GOD LØN

Vi tilbyder en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Men vi er også ærlige: Du starter ikke på en direktørløn.

Som rengøringsassistent får du ikke automatisk lederansvar, højere løntrin, fri firmabil, fri telefon eller andre goder, der følger med større ansvar.

Det arbejder man sig frem til.

Når du tager ansvar, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte en større rolle, følger mulighederne med.

DINE OPGAVER

Du skal først og fremmest kunne det vigtigste:

Rengøring.

Du kommer til at arbejde hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn, både private hjem og erhvervskunder.

Du skal kunne arbejde professionelt og selvstændigt og forstå, at vores kunder forventer et resultat, de kan være stolte af.

Hos RenTid skal rengøring ikke bare overstås.

Det skal gøres ordentligt.

Du skal have øje for detaljerne, tage ansvar og sætte en ære i at levere et resultat, der lever op til RenTids standarder.

HVAD FORVENTER VI AF DIG?

Vi forventer ikke, at du er perfekt. Men vi forventer, at du vil blive bedre.

Du skal:

  • Være mødestabil og fleksibel

  • Have en positiv attitude

  • Have lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

  • Kunne arbejde selvstændigt og i team

  • Have øje for detaljer

  • Sætte en ære i et perfekt resultat

  • Tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kunne modtage og bruge feedback konstruktivt

  • Være loyal over for kunder, kollegaer og RenTid

  • Være løsningsorienteret

  • Kunne bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag

  • Have kørekort kategori B

  • Selv kunne komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus

  • Være indforstået med, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde

  • Tale, forstå, læse, og skrive Engelsk

Har du ikke kørekort B, eller ønsker du ikke at køre bil, er stillingen ikke den rette for dig.

⭐ ERFARING ER VIGTIGT

Vi søger en person med stor erfaring inden for rengøring i private hjem. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er det ikke dig, vi søger.

Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring er en klar fordel.

Du skal kende de grundlæggende principper inden for professionel rengøring og kunne arbejde effektivt uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Hos RenTid skærer vi ikke hjørnerne. Vi gør tingene ordentligt.

Men erfaring alene er ikke nok.

Vi leder også efter:

Mindset. Arbejdsmoral. Ansvar. Vilje. Drive.

Du skal have lyst til at blive bedre – og lyst til at blive mere.

⏱️ DE FØRSTE 3 MÅNEDER

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode i henhold til gældende danske regler.

Det er en periode, hvor både du og vi finder ud af, om vi er det rigtige match.

Vi ser blandt andet på:

  • Hvordan du møder på arbejde

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder

  • Hvordan du fungerer med kollegaer

  • Hvordan du reagerer på feedback

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har lyst til at lære

  • Om du har det drive, vi leder efter

Hvis svaret er ja, kan de første tre måneder blive begyndelsen på noget langt større.

HOS RеNTID KAN DU UDVIKLE DIG

Vi tror på, at mennesker kan udvikle sig.

Derfor vil vi hellere finde den rigtige person med det rigtige mindset end den flotteste titel på CV'et.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan blive leder.

Vis os det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan tage ansvar.

Tag det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du har ambitioner.

Vis dem.

HVIS DU VIL MERE...

Vi kan ikke love dig en lederstilling om seks måneder, en firmabil om et år eller en direktørløn.

Det skal du gøre dig fortjent til.

Men vi kan love dig dette:

Hvis du arbejder hårdt, tager ansvar, udvikler dig, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte mere, så vil vi gerne give dig mulighederne for at vokse.

For når RenTid vokser, skal vores medarbejdere have mulighed for at vokse med.

Her starter alle på gulvet. Hvor langt du kan komme derfra, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Stillingen er primært i Aarhus og omegn.

Du skal kunne transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen og være indstillet på, at arbejdsdagen kan foregå hos forskellige kunder.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en ansøgning og dit CV med billede, hvor du fortæller:

  • Hvem du er

  • Hvor længe du har arbejdet med rengøring

  • Din erfaring med private hjem

  • Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

  • Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

  • Hvorfor du passer godt ind hos RenTid

Skriv gerne din ansøgning på Engelsk Mærk ansøgningen "The Journey".

"Jeg skal med på rejsen"

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

JOIN US ON THE JOURNEY!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaner with ambition

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaner who is highly skilled at their profession and wants to develop further.

Perhaps you have many years of experience in cleaning, private homes, commercial cleaning, quality control or coordination. Or perhaps you simply know that you have more to offer than you currently get the opportunity to show.

Then RenTid might be the right place for you.

⚠️ ONE IMPORTANT THING YOU NEED TO KNOW

At RenTid, everyone starts on the floor.

You will be hired as a cleaner – not as a manager, supervisor or director.

You start alongside everyone else, working directly with our customers and the cleaning itself.

We are less interested in titles and more interested in seeing:

  • What you can do

  • How you work

  • Your attitude and work ethic

  • How you treat customers and colleagues

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you have what it takes to grow with RenTid

WHERE CAN THIS JOURNEY TAKE YOU?

We don't know in advance.

That depends on you.

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right person can gradually take on more responsibility, such as:

  • Responsibility for specific customers

  • Quality control

  • Training new employees

  • Coordinating colleagues

  • Planning tasks

  • Customer communication

  • Responsibility for specific areas

  • Team leader responsibilities

  • Operational responsibility

  • Greater responsibility within the company over time

There are many opportunities if you show that you are ready for them.

Greater responsibility, higher salary and additional benefits come with what you demonstrate that you can handle.

YOU START WITH A GOOD SALARY

We offer a good and fair salary from day one.

But we are also honest: You will not start on a director's salary.

Management responsibility, higher salary levels, private use of a company car, company phone and other benefits are not automatic.

They are things you work your way towards.

As you take responsibility and deliver results, the opportunities will follow.

YOUR INITIAL ROLE

First and foremost, you need to be able to do the most important thing:

Clean.

You will work at customer locations in Aarhus and the surrounding areas, including private homes and commercial clients.

You must be able to work professionally and independently and understand that our customers expect a result they can be proud of.

At RenTid, cleaning is not something to rush through.

It has to be done properly.

You should have an eye for detail, take responsibility and take pride in meeting RenTid's standards.

WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

We don't expect you to be perfect. But we expect you to want to become better.

You must:

  • Be reliable and flexible

  • Have a positive attitude

  • Be willing to learn and develop

  • Work independently and as part of a team

  • Have an eye for detail

  • Take pride in delivering a perfect result

  • Take responsibility for your work

  • Receive and use feedback constructively

  • Be loyal to customers, colleagues and RenTid

  • Be solution-oriented

  • Maintain an overview in a busy environment

  • Have a valid Category B driving licence

  • Be able to get to and from work in Aarhus independently

  • Be comfortable with possible weekend work

  • Speak, understand, read, and write English

If you do not have a Category B licence or do not want to drive, this position is not for you.

⭐ EXPERIENCE MATTERS

We are looking for someone with extensive experience cleaning private homes. If you do not have this experience, this position is not for you.

Experience with commercial cleaning is a clear advantage.

You should already understand professional cleaning principles and be able to work efficiently without compromising quality.

At RenTid, we don't cut corners. We do things properly.

Experience alone is not enough.

We are also looking for:

Mindset. Work ethic. Responsibility. Determination. Drive.

You must want to become better – and want to become more.

⏱️ THE FIRST 3 MONTHS

The first 3 months are a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish employment law.

This is a period where both you and RenTid can determine whether we are the right match.

We will look at:

  • How you show up for work

  • How you work

  • How you treat customers

  • How you work with colleagues

  • How you respond to feedback

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you want to learn

  • Whether you have the drive we are looking for

If the answer is yes, these first three months could be the beginning of something much bigger.

AT RENTID, YOU CAN DEVELOP

We believe people can develop.

That is why we would rather find the right person with the right mindset than the person with the most impressive title on their CV.

You don't need to tell us you can become a manager.

Show us.

You don't need to tell us you can take responsibility.

Take it.

You don't need to tell us you have ambition.

Show us.

IF YOU WANT MORE...

We cannot promise you a management position in six months, a company car in a year or a director's salary.

You have to earn it.

But we can promise you this:

If you work hard, take responsibility, develop yourself, deliver results and show that you can handle more, we want to give you opportunities to grow.

Because when RenTid grows, our employees should have the opportunity to grow with it.

Everyone starts on the floor. How far you go from there will largely depend on you.

WORKING AREA

The position is primarily based in Aarhus and the surrounding areas.

You must be able to travel to and from work and be comfortable working at different customer locations.

RenTid provides a car for you or your team during working hours.

DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Then we would love to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV with a photo, including:

  • Who you are

  • How long you have worked in cleaning

  • Your experience with private homes

  • Any commercial cleaning experience

  • What you would like to develop within

  • Why you believe you would be a good fit for RenTid

Please write your application in English . Please mark your application: “The Journey”.

"I want to join the journey"

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

title: PhD Position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education
description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a three-year PhD position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This is a unique position in that research and its consequences sit in the same place. You will not be studying a distant phenomenon and writing it up; you will be running studies in live courses, designing interventions from what you find, and seeing them change how software engineering is taught. If you see yourself as someone who wants to help our discipline navigate the AI disruption rather than wait for it to settle, this is that opportunity.

 

Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and conduct empirical studies of how software engineering students generally use generative AI — how they justify it, what they delegate to it, and where their agency is preserved or surrendered.

  • Translate those findings into agency artifacts, practicum activities, and assessment designs that can be used by real instructors in real courses.

  • Co-develop and evaluate self-learning components, and contribute to alignment work on intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment together with the ITU stream.

  • Work directly with the head of programs and instructors to implement classroom interventions, whose buy-in is what makes this kind of change hold. Persuading colleagues is part of the craft here, not an afterthought.

  • Publish in leading venues for computing education research, and present internationally.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a closely related field, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree and including a substantial thesis component. The degree must be completed before the starting date. Students with master’s in education and related fields are welcome to apply.

  • A grade average at or above 10 on the Danish 7-point scale, or a documented equivalent from the awarding institution. Applicants with degrees from outside Denmark should include a grading scale and, where available, a conversion statement.

  • Documented ability to carry out independent scientific work, evidenced by the master’s thesis.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • A software engineering background, with practical familiarity with how software is actually built — you should be able to judge whether an AI-assisted solution is sound, not only whether it runs.

  • A genuine motivation for teaching and education, both in delivery and as an object of research.

  • The ability to design and carry out empirical studies involving students, and to engage stakeholders for support.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Prior research and publication experience.

  • Experience with empirical research methods — interventions, experiment, interviews, coding, thematic or pattern analysis — and with mixed-methods designs.

  • Familiarity with computing education research, or with constructive alignment as a course design framework.

  • Teaching or teaching-assistant experience at university level.

  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in software development, and a considered view of where they help and where they do not.

 

Personal competences

  • Critical and ingenious thinking. You question assumptions — including your own, including ours, and including the ones embedded in our education design and the AI tools you will be studying. You are as interested in what a finding does not show as in what it does.

  • A demonstrated passion for software engineering and its education. This project asks you to care about how the next generation of engineers is formed, not only about publishing on the topic.

  • The ability to bring colleagues along. Much of this work happens through instructors and program leaderships who own their courses. We value someone who can earn agreement through evidence, patience, and good listening rather than argument alone.

  • Independence paired with collaboration. You will drive your own studies, and you will do it inside a two-university project with shared deliverables and deadlines.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be researching people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

  • Comfort with iteration. Design-based research means your first intervention will be wrong in interesting ways. That is the method working, not failing.

 

Workplace description

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Two recommendation letters, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Muud nõuded: Ootame Sinult:​

description:
.

Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.

Other requirements: • Professional culinary education or vocational training in cooking, baking, pastry, catering, or a related field is preferred; equivalent substantial professional experience may also be considered.
• Strong practical culinary skills, including food preparation, cooking, baking, confectionary, dough preparation and handling, portioning, and product presentation. • Experience with layered or filled dough products, pastries, or similar baked products is highly desirable. • Ability to organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, prioritize tasks, manage high-volume periods, and maintain consistent product quality and availability. • Previous experience guiding or supervising kitchen staff and coordinating work with service staff. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleaning, storage, and occupational safety requirements. • Experience with inventory, stock control, ordering, deliveries, stock rotation, write-offs, and waste control. • Comfortable using POS, inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, and basic kitchen/production management software. • Strong attention to detail, organization, leadership, communication, problem-solving, and ability to work effectively under pressure. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, trustworthy, and committed to quality, cleanliness, teamwork, and customer satisfaction.

title: Reoveepuhastite operaator
description:
Tööülesanded: Kas soovid teha tööd, millel on reaalne ja puhas mõju keskkonnale? Liitu meeskonnaga!
𝗔𝗦 𝗛𝗔𝗟𝗝𝗔𝗟𝗔 𝗦𝗢𝗢𝗝𝗨𝗦 otsib oma meeskonda kohusetundlikku ja tehnilise taibuga 𝗿𝗲𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗲𝗽𝘂𝗵𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘁, kelle peamiseks ülesandeks on tagada puhastusprotsesside tõrgeteta ja efektiivne toimimine. 𝗣𝗲𝗮𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼̈𝗼̈𝘂̈𝗹𝗲𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗱: • 𝗦𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗲 𝗷𝘂𝗵𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗲: Reoveepuhasti seadmete ja tehnoloogiliste protsesside igapäevane jälgimine ning reguleerimine 𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗷𝗮𝗹𝗮 𝘃𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗮 territooriumil. • 𝗛𝗼𝗼𝗹𝗱𝘂𝘀 𝗷𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁: Puhasti seadmete (pumbad, mikserid, filtrid jne) hooldustööde teostamine ja jooksvate rikete kõrvaldamine. • 𝗞𝘃𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗶 𝗸𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗹: Proovide võtmine, lihtsamate analüüside tegemine ja tulemuste dokumenteerimine. • 𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗸𝗼𝗿𝗱: Puhasti territooriumi ja hoonete puhtuse ning korra tagamine. • 𝗩𝗮𝗹𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗹𝗲𝗸 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗸𝘀: Osalemine valverütmis (vajadusel väljakutsetele reageerimine väljaspool tavapärast tööaega).

Omalt poolt pakume: • 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗶𝗹𝘀𝘂𝘀𝘁: Kindlat ja pikaajalist tööd elutähtsas valdkonnas.
• 𝗩𝗮̈𝗹𝗷𝗮𝗼̃𝗽𝗲𝘁: Põhjalikku kohapealset juhendamist ja erialaseid täiendkoolitusi. • 𝗧𝗼̈𝗼̈𝘃𝗮𝗵𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗶𝗱: Kaasaegseid tööriistu ja isikukaitsevahendeid. • 𝗧𝗼𝗲𝘁𝘂𝘀𝘁: Sõbralikku ja toetavat meeskonda. • 𝗧𝗼̈𝗼̈𝘁𝗮𝘀𝘂: Konkurentsivõimelist palka.

Muud nõuded: 𝗢𝗼𝘁𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗸𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗹𝗲:
• 𝗧𝗲𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗽: Huvi tehnika, mehaanika või automaatika vastu (suureks eeliseks on eelnev töökogemus tootmises, lukksepana või operaatorina). • 𝗔𝗿𝘃𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝘀𝗸𝘂𝘀: Tavapärane arvutikasutuse oskus seadmete infosüsteemide (SCADA) jälgimiseks. • 𝗜𝘀𝗶𝗸𝘂𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗱𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗱: Kohusetunne, täpsus, iseseisvus ja hea füüsiline vorm. • 𝗝𝘂𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗼𝗮𝗱: B-kategooria juhilubade olemasolu. • 𝗞𝗲𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗼𝘀𝗸𝘂𝘀: Hea eesti keele oskus kõnes ja kirjas.

description:
Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda ostuspetsialisti, kes aitab hoida ostuosakonna igapäevatöö sujuvana ning andmed ja dokumendid korras. Sinu panus aitab tagada, et tootmiseks vajalik tooraine oleks õigel ajal tellitud ja oluline info jõuaks õigete inimesteni.
SINU PEAMISED ÜLESANDED ON: • lood ja seadistad kaupade andmeid infosüsteemis ning hoiad materjalide ja tarnijate info ajakohasena; • tellid koostöös vahetu juhiga toorainet, vajadusel tegeled allhangetega ning haldad ostutellimusi; • küsid tarnijatelt hinnapakkumisi, võrdled hindu ja aitad valida sobivaima lahenduse; • suhtled igapäevaselt kangatarnijatega, küsides hindu, saadavust, tarneaegu, minimaalseid tellimiskoguseid ja muid ostutingimusi; • tegeled koos kvaliteediosakonna ning tarnijatega kvaliteediprobleemide ja reklamatsioonide lahendamisega; • jälgid materjalide saadavust ja tarneid ning reageerid õigeaegselt võimalikele tarneriskidele ja puudujääkidele; • analüüsid materjalide hindu ja hinnamuutusi ning toetad ostuhindade ja kulude optimeerimist; • koordineerid kangaste proovide, värvikaartide, laboriproovide ja muude materjalinäidiste tellimist ning liikumist; • teed koostööd tootmise, planeerimise, kvaliteedi, arenduse ja müügimeeskonnaga, et tagada vajalike materjalide õigeaegne ja optimaalne saadavus; • haldad ostudokumentatsiooni ning infot tarnijate ja klientide portaalides; • aitad koostada ja ajakohastada osakonna juhendeid ning teavitad müügi- ja planeerimismeeskonda tarnetõrgetest.

Omalt poolt pakume: • stabiilset tööd rahvusvahelises ja arenevas ettevõttes;
• vaheldusrikast tööd, kus saad panustada ostuprotsessi sujuvusse ja õppida tundma rahvusvahelise tootmisettevõtte igapäevatööd; • põhjalikku väljaõpet ja toetavat sisseelamist; • toetavat ja sõbralikku meeskonda, kellega on hea ühiste eesmärkide nimel töötada; • arengu- ja koolitusvõimalusi ning ettevõtte pakutavaid hüvesid.

Muud nõuded: SOBID HÄSTI MEIE MEESKONDA, KUI:
• oled täpne, korrektne ja vastutustundlik; • oskad oma tööd iseseisvalt korraldada ning väärtustad koostööd; • oled hea suhtleja ja naudid meeskonnas töötamist; • kasutad arvutit väga heal tasemel ning tunned end andmete ja dokumentidega töötades kindlalt; • valdad eesti keelt ning oskad inglise keeles suhelda nii kõnes kui ka kirjas; • oled omandanud vähemalt keskhariduse.

title: Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist
description:
Vire Advisors kasvaa, ja etsimme uutta osaajaa tiimiin. Keskeinen ajatuksemme **Vaikuttava HR ei ole käsityötä** ohjaa tekemistämme. Sinun tehtäväsi on auttaa tekemään siitä ajatus, jonka markkina tuntee, muistaa ja mielellään myös jakaa eteenpäin.

Autamme yrityksiä modernisoimaan johtamista ja HR-tekemistä teknologian, automaatioiden ja tekoälyn avulla. Samalla rakennamme omia teknologiaratkaisujamme, ja SaaS-alustamme **Arviro©** on nyt siinä vaiheessa, että se tarvitsee työbestiksen, jolla on markkinoinnin seniori-osaamista, vauhtia ja joka osaa vahvistaa SaaS tuotteistamisen kaupallista ajattelua.

Etsimme siis kokenutta **Senior Marketing & Growth Specialistia** vahvistamaan brändiämme, kasvattamaan näkyvyyttämme ja rakentamaan markkinointia, joka näkyy myös liiketoiminnan tuloksissa.

Roolissa yhdistyvät sisältömarkkinointi, sosiaalinen media, tapahtumat, digitaalinen näkyvyys ja kasvun rakentaminen. Etsimme ihmistä, joka osaa rakentaa suunnan mutta ei kavahda käytännön tekemistä.

**Mitä työssäsi teet?**

Vastaat Vire Advisors sisältömarkkinoinnin, sosiaalisen median ja kasvua tukevan markkinoinnin suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- sisältökalenterin ja uusien sisältökonseptien rakentaminen

- LinkedIn- ja Instagram-sisältöjen suunnittelu ja toteutus

- blogien, uutiskirjeiden, asiakastarinoiden ja verkkosisältöjen kirjoittaminen

- asiantuntijoiden ajatusten jalostaminen sisällöiksi, joita muutkin kuin asiantuntijat haluavat lukea

- kampanjoiden, webinaarien, messujen ja asiakastilaisuuksien suunnittelu ja toteutus

- verkkosivujen, SEO:n ja AI-haun kehittäminen

- markkinointimateriaalien ja landing pagejen rakentaminen

- analytiikan, liidien ja eri kanavien tulosten seuranta

- markkinoinnin työkalujen ja tekoälyn aktiivinen hyödyntäminen.


Hyvä sisältö ei ole meille itseisarvo. Sen pitää rakentaa tunnettavuuutta, herättää kiinnostusta, vahvistaa asiantuntijabrändiä, synnyttää liidejä ja tukea myyntiä.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme kokenutta B2B-markkinoijaa, jolla on jo näyttöjä siitä, mitä on omalla osaamisellaan saavuttanut.

Toivomme sinulta:

- vahvaa kokemusta B2B-markkinoinnista

- vahvaa sisältömarkkinoinnin ja kirjoittamisen osaamista

- erittäin hyvää LinkedIn- ja Instagram-osaamista

- kokemusta tapahtumista, webinaareista ja kampanjoista

- ymmärrystä SEO:sta, verkkosivuista, analytiikasta ja liidien muodostumisesta

- hyvää visuaalista silmää

- vahvaa markkinoinnin työkalujen tuntemusta

- kykyä hyödyntää tekoälyä tehokkaasti omassa työssäsi

- erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen osaamista. Aiemmin kokemus kansainvälisiltä markkinoilta on vahva etu.


**Aikaisempi kokemus kasvuyrityksestä sekä SaaS-, teknologia-, asiantuntija- tai ratkaisumyynnin markkinoinnista on meille erittäin tärkeää.** Ja jos tiedät ja osaat selkeästi perustella, että markkinoinnin onnistuminen näkyy muuallakin kuin seuraajamäärässä, saat meiltä monta tykkäystä.

**Millainen henkilö menestyy meillä?**

Menestyt tässä roolissa, jos olet samaan aikaan luova, kaupallinen ja systemaattinen. Tartut asioihin itsenäisesti, viet ideat käytäntöön ja osaat muuttaa suuntaa nopeasti, jos data kertoo, ettei jokin toimi.

Pidät ihmisistä, tapahtumista ja keskusteluista ja saat mielellään asiantuntijasta irti ajatuksen, jota hän ei itse edes tajunnut olevan julkaisemisen arvoinen (big ask, we know ). Uskallat myös haastaa tiiminjäseniä! Huonot ideat nostetaan rohkeasti pöytään ja tehdään niistä yhdessä parempia.

Kasvuyrityksessä kaikki ei ole valmiiksi pureskeltua. Jos tarvitset täydellisen tehtävänannon, kolmen viikon hyväksyntäkierroksen ja kuusi allekirjoitusta ennen julkaisua, emme ehkä ole täydellinen match.

Jos taas nautit siitä, että pääset rakentamaan, kokeilemaan ja näkemään oman kädenjälkesi nopeasti, hae meille!

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Saat laajan roolin kasvuyrityksessä, jossa markkinointi on yksi kasvun tärkeimmistä moottoreista.

Pääset työskentelemään suoraan omistajien, asiantuntijoiden, myynnin ja teknologiatiimin kanssa sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä Vire Advisors ja Arviro näyttävät ja kuulostavat seuraavassa kasvuvaiheessaan.

Saat vastuuta, vapautta ja tilaa tehdä asioita paremmin kuin me olemme niitä tähän asti tehneet. Itse asiassa sitä me sinulta odotammekin.

**Työpaikka:** Vire Advisors

**Tehtävänimike:** Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist

**Työsuhde:** Vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, se voi myös olla osa-aikainen ja/tai toiminimiyrittäjä. Olemme avoimia monenlaisille työsuhdemuodoille, kunhan osaaminen ja omistautuneisuus ovat kohdallaan.

**Sijainti / hybridityö:** Vire Advisors on tällä hetkellä 100% remote. Ainakin toistaiseksi. Ehdotuksia otetaan vastaan.

**Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian, mutta sovittavissa. Meidän monilahjakas markkinoinnin assistentti Sanna päättää määräaikaisuutensa 16.10.2026.

**Hakuaika:** Än, yy, tee, nyt! Hakuaika alkaa nyt, ja päättyy viimeistään 23.10.2026

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä meille CV ja kerro erityisesti siitä, mistä olet oman osaamisesi suhteen ylpeä, mitä onnistumisia haluat tuoda esiin. Voit mielellään näyttää meille sisältöjä, kampanjoita, tapahtumia tai muita kokonaisuuksia, joista olet ylpeä ja jotka mielestäsi tukevat hakemustasi.

**Meitä kiinnostaa vähemmän se, mistä olet ollut vastuussa. Meitä kiinnostaa enemmän se, mitä sinun ansiostasi tapahtui.**

title: Business Controller, Vianor
description:
Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.

We are looking for a Business Controller, Vianor to join our team.

The Business Controller, Vianor acts as a senior finance business partner to the Vianor business leadership, providing financial insight, analysis and challenge to support performance management, profitability improvement and strategic decision-making. The role combines strong business understanding, disciplined financial planning and reporting, and the ability to translate complex financial information into clear business actions.

Key responsibilities:

- ·Financial leadership and business partnering: Provide proactive financial support, challenge and insights to Vianor business leadership and country organizations. Act as a trusted sparring partner in identifying performance drivers, risks, opportunities and concrete improvement actions.
- Performance management and profitability analysis: Lead analysis of business performance across sales, margin, cost, operating profit, working capital and cash flow. Support the business in understanding key profitability drivers, including customer, product, country and price-volume-mix dynamics.
- Planning, forecasting and budgeting: Own and coordinate key financial planning processes for Vianor, including monthly estimates, annual budgeting and long-range planning, in close cooperation with business leadership and country finance teams.
- Reporting and financial transparency: Ensure timely, accurate and meaningful financial reporting for Vianor and support country companies in monthly reporting. Continuously improve reporting quality, management insight and visualization of key financial information.
- Investment, business case and strategic support: Support business development, investment decisions, expansion initiatives and M&A-related activities by providing robust financial analysis, business case modelling and standardized evaluation methods.
- Process, tools and ways-of-working development: Drive continuous improvement of financial processes, planning practices, reporting tools and analytical methods. Promote efficient use of systems, data and digital tools, including business intelligence and AI-supported analysis.
- Governance, controls and audit support: Support sound financial governance, internal cost allocation, inventory-related follow-up and audit processes for Vianor and relevant country companies.

What we expect from you:

- A masters degree, preferably in finance, accounting or economics.
- Solid experience in business controlling, financial planning and analysis, reporting or a comparable senior finance role, preferably in an international, multi-entity environment.
- Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, profitability drivers and financial performance management.
- Proven ability to act as a business partner to senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and convert financial analysis into practical business recommendations.
- Experience in budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, investment analysis and business case modelling.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial topics for business audiences.

title: Perhetukikeskuksen johtaja, lastensuojelu, Mäntymäki
description:
Tehtäväsi

Mäntymäen perhetukikeskuksen johtajana vastaat perhetukikeskuksen toiminnasta, sen kehittämisestä ja henkilöstöjohtamisesta.

Mäntymäen perhetukikeskus on Turussa sijaitseva 18-paikkainen vastaanottoyksikkö kiireellisesti tai avohuollon tukitoimena sijoitetuille lapsille. Johdettavanasi työskentelee moniammatillinen henkilöstö, johon kuuluu 26 perhetukikeskuksen ohjaajaa, 3 vastaavaa ohjaajaa, 3 perheohjaajaa, sairaanhoitaja, 2 kokkia sekä 0,5 laitoshuoltajaa.

Tehtävässäsi vastaat toiminnan laadukkaasta johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä sekä henkilöstön arviointi- ja vastaanottotyöskentelyn ohjaamisesta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä lasten, perheiden ja heidän verkostojensa kanssa sekä varmistat toiminnan sujuvuuden myös vaativissa ja haastavissa tilanteissa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle vastuullisen ja vaikuttavan johtamistehtävän lastensuojelun keskeisessä palvelussa.

Pääset työssäsi hyödyntämään osaamistasi sekä kehittämään vastaanottotyötä ja palveluja yhdessä osaavan moniammatillisen henkilöstön kanssa. Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa sekä yksikön toimintaan että lasten ja perheiden saaman tuen laatuun.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta vahvaa kokemusta lastensuojelun laitoshuollosta sekä johtamisesta. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kehittämismyönteistä työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä johtaa henkilöstön arviointi- ja vastaanottotyöskentelyä lasten, perheiden ja heidän verkostojensa kanssa myös haastavissa tilanteissa.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on ylempi korkeakoulututkinto sekä kokemus alan johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä.

Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa sekä tyydyttävää suullista ja kirjallista ruotsin kielen taitoa.

Jos haluat yhdistää vahvan lastensuojelun osaamisen, henkilöstöjohtamisen ja toiminnan kehittämisen merkityksellisessä tehtävässä, odotamme hakemustasi.

title: Iltapäiväkerhotoiminnan ohjaaja
description:
Huvikumpu ry hakee innokasta ja motivoitunutta iltapäivätoiminnan ohjaajaa täydentämään reipashenkistä ja aurinkoista työtiimiä. Huvikumpu ry järjestää perusopetuksen iltapäivätoimintaa Porvoon keskuskoululla.

Meille mieluisa työkaveri olisi positiivinen ja oma-aloitteinen. Odotamme, että kollegamme on motivoitunut ohjaamaan lapsia monipuolisesti mm. erilaisten kädentaitojen, retkien ja liikunnan parissa. Järjestämme lapsille mielekästä ohjattua toimintaa päivittäin, mutta toki jätämme tilaa myös leikille sekä vapaalle ulkoilulle. Työ on hyvin monipuolista ja antoisaa, varaamme laadun takaamiseksi myös aikaa suunnitteluun mm. kuukausipalavereiden ja tiimipalavereiden muodossa. Yksikön vahvana tukena toimii koordinaattori sekä kaksi palveluntuottajaa.

Ohjaajan tehtävänä on mm. koululaisten iltapäivätoiminnan suunnittelu, toteutus ja ohjaus yhdessä muun työtiimin kanssa. Tehtäviin kuuluu myös yhteydenpito sekä yhteistyö niin kouluun kuin vanhempiinkin. Noudatamme kerhoissamme teema-kuukaudet ajattelua sekä viikko-ohjelmaa, näin takaamme mielekästä ja vaihtelevaa ohjelmaa lapsille. Tärkeä osa laadukasta iltapäivätoimintaamme on ns. maksuton kerhotoiminta, jota suunnittelemme ja toteutamme perheiden ja lasten toiveiden pohjalta.

Huvikummussa on käytössä perehdytyskansio, jonka avulla uusien työntekijöiden on helppo ja mukava aloittaa työt. Työntekijöistämme pitää huolta Terveystalo ja henkilökuntaamme koulutamme vähintään kaksi kertaa vuodessa pidetyissä koulutuspäivissä. Lisäksi järjestämme työyhteisön virkistyspäiviä muutaman kerran vuodessa, hyvinvoiva työyhteisö on meille sydämen asia.

Työhön sopiva koulutus/ tutkinto voisi olla esim. liikuntaneuvoja, liikunnanohjaaja AMK, aamu- ja iltapäivätoiminnan ohjaaja, artenomi, lähihoitaja, sosionomi, nuoriso- ja vapaa-ajanohjaaja. Katsomme eduksi myös erityisen tuen oppilaiden kanssa työskentelyn taidon. Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rikosrekisteriote.

Jos olet innokas kuulemaan lisää, niin ota rohkeasti yhteyttä! Juuri sinä voit olla meidän uusi työkaverimme.

Hakemuksen ja CV:n voi jättää osoitteeseen: palveluntuottajat@huvikumpury.fi

title: Inhoppare som kock inom äldreomsorgen
description:
Vill du ha ett givande och trivsamt jobb där du bidrar till att matgäster serveras god, vällagad och näringsrik sammansatt kost? Serviceboendet Sveagården med heldygnsomsorg inom äldreomsorgen i Lemlands kommun söker dig som vill arbeta som kock med kortare vikariat/inhopp. Stor möjlighet finns för längre vikariat på grund av föräldraledighet.

**Din roll hos oss** Som kock deltar du i måltidsplaneringen och ser till att måltiderna följer kostpolicyn för de äldre i Lemlands kommun. Tillsammans med ansvarig kock tillagar ni måltider för de boende på Sveagården samt lunch för pensionärer och andra vårdbehövande i kommunen.

Du delar ansvar med ansvarig kock gällande att hygienkraven följs.

**Din profil** Vi söker dig som har en gymnasialutbildning inom branschen, samt hygienpass. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av liknande arbete.

Vi förutsätter att kost och matlagning ligger dig varmt om hjärtat och du delar uppfattningen att måltiden är en viktig del av vardagen. Du är van att ta egna initiativ och arbetar på ett strukturerat sätt. Som person är du engagerad, flexibel och har god samarbetsförmåga.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och lämplighet.

**Vår rekryteringsprocess** Lemlands kommun rekryterar fördomsfritt och objektivt. Intervjuer kan komma ske löpande under ansökningstiden.

**Om vår kommun** Lemlands kommun är en mellanstor kommun ur ett åländskt perspektiv, men en liten kommun i ett större omvärldsperspektiv. Här finns det utrymme för att både vara liten och stor på samma gång. Lemlands kommun ger service till kommuninvånarna inom allt från barnomsorg till vattenledningsnät. Av kommunens ca 120 anställda arbetar ungefär 10 % med administration, medan de flesta arbetar med service nära kommuninvånarna inom barnomsorg, skola, äldreomsorg, bibliotek och fritidsverksamhet.

Hos oss erbjuds du en trivsam arbetsmiljö med varierande arbetsuppgifter.

För mera information om arbetet, vänligen kontakta Ledande vårdare Andréa Mattsson, +358 (0)18 34228 eller andrea.mattsson@lemland.ax.

Skicka ansökan till:

Vi ser fram emot att få din ansökan med personligt brev samt CV. Ansökan skickas via länken https://e-tjanster.ax/e-form/sv/8c1a47cae1, senast 13 oktober 2026. Alternativt via e-post: aldreomsorgen@lemland.ax eller via postadress: Lemlands kommun, Kommunrundan 7, 22610 Lemland

Märk din ansökan med Inhoppare kock Sveagården.

title: Palomies, kesätyö ja muut sijaisuudet, Länsi-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitos
description:
Palomies, tervetuloa joukkoomme Länsi-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitokselle!

Palomiehen tehtäviin kuuluu osallistuminen pelastustoimintaan, ensihoitopalvelujen tuottamiseen sekä onnettomuuksien ehkäisytyöhön. Onnettomuuksien ehkäisyyn liittyvät tehtävät sisältävät muun muassa turvallisuusviestintää sekä neuvonta- ja valistustehtäviä.

Tarjoamme käyttöösi nykyaikaiset henkilökohtaiset suojavarusteet sekä modernin pelastuskaluston. Panostamme henkilöstömme osaamisen jatkuvaan kehittämiseen ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia erikoistua erilaisiin tehtäviin, kuten pelastussukeltajaksi tai venemieheksi.

Länsi-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitoksella henkilöstön työhyvinvointia ja ammatillista kehittymistä tuetaan suunnitelmallisesti. Esihenkilöitä koulutetaan jatkuvasti, jotta henkilöstöllä on käytettävissään laadukas tuki päivittäisessä työssään. Lisäksi alueellemme rakennetaan uusia paloasemia, mikä vahvistaa palvelutuotantoa ja tarjoaa monipuolisia työskentelymahdollisuuksia eri puolilla Länsi-Uuttamaata.

Pelastajatutkintoa suorittavien hakijoiden osalta palvelussuhteen edellytykset arvioidaan tapauskohtaisesti. Tällä hakemuksella voit hakea sekä kesän vuosilomasijaisuuksiin että muihin määräaikaisiin palomiehen tehtäviin. Ilmoitathan hakemuksessasi minkä pituisesta sijaisuudesta olet kiinnostunut ja sen ajankohdasta.

Länsi-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitos tarjoaa mahdollisuuden työskennellä vaativissa ja merkityksellisissä tehtävissä osana ammattitaitoista ja kehittyvää työyhteisöä

Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue / Länsi-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitos, Palomiehentie 1, 02750 Espoo

Työaika: Poikkeusluvan mukainen vuorokausirytmi, 42 tuntia viikossa.

Tehtävät ovat määräaikaisia. Aloitusajankohta sovitaan erikseen.

Kelpoisuusvaatimukset: Päätoimiselta pelastustoimintaan osallistuvalta miehistöltä vaadittava kelpoisuus.

Tehtävässä edellytetään:
- tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa.
- että hakija antaa pyydettäessä luvan turvallisuusselvityslain (726/2014) mukaisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen ja päihdeohjelman mukaisen huumausainetestin tekemiseen.
- BC-luokan ajokorttia.

Arvostamme: Laaja-alaista osaamista, niin pelastustoimesta kuin muilta aloilta ja kokemusta perustason ensihoitajana toimimisesta sekä ruotsin kielentaitoa. Ikään suhteutettu erinomainen fyysinen suorituskyky katsotaan eduksi.

Kiinnostuitko? Odotamme innoissamme hakemustasi! Jätäthän sen Kuntarekryn hakuportaalin kautta.

Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Tarjoamme lounasedun ja saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin. Lisäksi pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi Eduhousen ja Oppiportin laajojen verkkokoulutusten avulla.

title: Service Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Service engineer for our client.

Your Role and Responsibilities:
As a Service Engineer, based in the Helsinki or Turku area, you will be responsible for commissioning, maintaining and servicing electric propulsion systems for marine applications. You will execute service work according to work instructions and in accordance with standard processes, quality requirements and safety guidelines.

You will work closely with customers and internal engineering and service teams, acting as the technical point of contact while ensuring high-quality service and customer satisfaction.

The position involves approximately 150 days of mostly international travel per year, as you will provide practical technical support at customer sites around the world. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work with advanced marine technology, develop your technical expertise and gain international experience in a highly customer-oriented industry.

You will be mainly accountable for:
 Commissioning and maintaining electric propulsion systems
 Supervising installations, startup, testing and commissioning in cooperation with customers
 Performing service and warranty work on operating vessels
 Installing and commissioning equipment and identifying and analysing technical problems through remote and on-site activities
 Performing various service tasks, including installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions and equipment replacements
 Consulting and advising customers on suitable service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures and safety guidelines
 Building and maintaining strong customer relationships and providing specialist technical assistance
 Diagnosing equipment failures and recommending corrective actions to prevent recurring problems
 Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and working methods

Qualifications for the Role:
 B.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, automation, marine engineering or another relevant field
 Ability and willingness to perform mechanical service work when required
 Previous practical experience in commissioning relevant products or systems is an advantage
 Willingness and ability to travel internationally extensively, up to approximately 150 days per year
 Experience in shipbuilding, marine systems or industrial equipment is an advantage
 Experience with electrical propulsion systems is considered an advantage
 Collaborative and solution-oriented approach
 Good Finnish and English language skills, as the role involves regular interaction with customers and internal teams
 Additional language skills are an advantage
 Good knowledge of MS Office
 Ability to work independently as well as effectively as part of a team
 Strong customer service and communication skills

More about the company:
Our client operates in the marine technology sector and develops advanced electric, automated and digital solutions for vessels and maritime operations. The company is committed to supporting the transition towards more sustainable and energy-efficient marine transportation.

You will join an international and dynamic working environment where advanced technology is delivered through large-scale projects around the world. The role offers the opportunity to work in a highly globalized, customer-oriented industry and develop your expertise through challenging international assignments.

The company values collaboration, continuous learning, customer focus and innovation, and offers a range of professional development and employee wellbeing benefits.

title: Junior Mechanical Design Engineer – Kickstart Your Career in Engineering!
description:
About the role

In this role, you will get the opportunity to develop mechanical components and assemblies while adapting existing designs to specific customer orders. The work perfectly combines practical design tasks with cross-functional collaboration across engineering, production, and supplier teams. You will be supported by experienced colleagues, making this a fantastic environment to grow your expertise in mechanical engineering and manufacturing documentation.

In this role, you will be employed in a 12-month fixed-term contract with our client company, working as an embedded consultant for an in-house product company.

What our client can offer to you:
- Salary: 2500–3500 €/month, depending on your background and current skill level.
- A strong start to your career: You will get hands-on experience in a real product company environment, learning the complete lifecycle from CAD design to manufacturing.
- A collaborative environment: You will work closely with different departments, ensuring you gain a broad understanding of industrial engineering.

Work tasks

Your daily tasks will revolve around 3D modeling and creating precise manufacturing documentation for customized orders. You will ensure that technical specifications are met and that production has the correct information to build the components.
- Producing and updating 3D models for mechanical parts and subsystems.
- Preparing accurate, detailed manufacturing drawings.
- Adapting established product designs to order-specific requirements.
- Keeping design records and related information up to date in PDM and ERP systems.
- Collaborating with sales, R&D, manufacturing, and suppliers.

The work contract is with our client company, a consultancy company and you

We are looking for

- Mandatory: A bachelors or masters degree in mechanical engineering (or currently finalizing your studies).
- Mandatory: Hands-on experience with PTC Creo. This can be from your studies, internships, thesis work, or academic/personal projects.
- Mandatory: Fluent communication skills in English.
- Advantage: Basic understanding of manufacturing methods, engineering fundamentals, and familiarity with PDM systems.
- Personality: You are eager to learn, responsive to feedback, and possess a careful, detail-oriented approach to your work.

Schedule for the recruitment:
- Application period is open now.
- We are processing applications continuously and aim to present the first candidates by mid-October.
- Client interviews will follow immediately after.

Location & Remote work:
- The client's office is located in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area. The role requires working at the office for a minimum of 2 days per week to ensure smooth onboarding and teamwork.

 

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.
