title: Senior Specialist, Product Operations - (Logistics Service) (Business-Analyst/in)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Specialist, Product Operations - Logistics Service to join the Product Performance team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

In our Logistics Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

Our Service Product line is responsible for all customer support-related products, including our in-house agent-facing tools for customer issue resolution, our self-service engine and our global compensation application. Within the Product line, you will be responsible for the performance of our products and work very closely with our product, analytics and data science teams and different entities across the globe to optimize them in order to maximize the value (both cost and top-line) to the business.

- Contribute to improving customer retention and resolving post-delivery issues, with a focus on optimizing self-service experiences
- Run analyses on customer behavior, product usage, and issue resolution patterns to identify opportunities that increase retention, improve experience, and reduce operational costs
- Collaborate closely with product managers, analytics teams, and data scientists to design and evaluate A/B tests and build actionable insights
- Monitor and report on key performance indicators related to retention and post-delivery, ensuring data is accurate, timely, and relevant
- Support regional and local teams by delivering targeted insights, dashboards, and recommendations within your area of specialization
- Identify and communicate areas for product and process enhancements, contributing to prioritization discussions with cross-functional teams
- Contribute to regular reporting and insights for stakeholders and leadership, highlighting both impact and opportunities for efficiency gains

Qualifications

- 4+ years of relevant experience (not counting internships) in a consulting or tech company, working in functions like product operations, user retention, pricing or revenue management
- You have at least a Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative subject - e.g. computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering, social sciences, psychology
- Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to draw insights from complex data sets
- You are self-driven and communicative, independent and pragmatic in handling business challenges
- You are proactive, intellectually curious, and motivated by shaping product and business strategy in a high-stakes environment
- Excellent hands on knowledge of reporting tools (Tableau or Looker Studio) & strong hands on knowledge in SQL

Nice to have

- Experience using AI tools in everyday work to bring efficiency and automation
- Experience in a similar large scale tech or e-commerce environment

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week

- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

title: Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) (Personalreferent/in)
description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

We are currently looking for a Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) for our Headquarters in Stuttgart / Germany.
The Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) is responsible for supporting the Vice President Compensation & Benefits and Mobility in designing, managing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving compensation and benefits programs to align across Exyte's global organization with the Global strategy. The role develops scalable, market-competitive, and compliant solutions that balance global consistency with local market and regulatory requirements. Working globally, this position partners with HR, Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external advisors to strengthen global job architecture, pay structures, incentive programs, benefits governance, and annual reward processes that support attraction, retention, engagement, and internal equity.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Global Reward Strategy & Program Design: Partner with the VP Compensation, Benefits & Global Mobility to develop and implement global compensation and benefits strategies, frameworks, and governance models that balance enterprise-wide consistency with local market, legal, and business requirements.
- Global Process Ownership & Execution: Lead and optimize global compensation and benefits processes, including annual salary reviews, bonus planning, pay decisions, budgeting, and benefits harmonization across multiple countries and regions.
- Global Analytics, Benchmarking & Technology: Drive global market benchmarking, reward analytics, pay equity assessments, workforce cost forecasting, and data-driven reporting to support strategic reward and workforce decisions.
- Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Establish and maintain robust global compensation and benefits policies, governance structures, and compliance frameworks while ensuring adherence to evolving regulatory and reporting requirements.
- Global Stakeholder Advisory & Change Enablement: Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders, leading global change initiatives, policy transformations, and reward program implementations.
- Vendor & External Partner Management: Own the global vendor strategy for Compensation & Benefits, including provider selection, contract management, service quality oversight, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Global Scope: Operate effectively across international regions, cultures, and time zones, fostering collaboration within a global environment and supporting business needs through occasional international travel.
- Program & Project Leadership: Lead complex global reward projects, including M&A integrations, job architecture initiatives, compensation technology implementations, pay transparency programs, benefits harmonization, and organizational change activities.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
- Multiple years of professional experience, including significant experience in global or multi-country compensation and benefits roles
- Deep expertise in global compensation and benefits strategy, job architecture, market benchmarking, salary structures, incentive design, and annual reward processes.
- Strong knowledge of global governance and the ability to translate enterprise principles into practical, locally compliant solutions.
- Experience working across multiple countries and regions within a complex, matrixed multinational organization.
- Advanced analytical, financial-modeling, and data-visualization capability, including expert-level Excel skills and experience with HRIS and reporting tools.
- Demonstrated ability to influence executives and align diverse global and regional stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong project, change, and vendor-management skills, with the ability to manage concurrent global initiatives.
- Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and cross-cultural communication skills; professional fluency in English.
- Fluent in German with a strong knowledge of German laws essential.

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Junior Controller Product Costing & Inventory Valuation (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER (Buchhalter/in)
description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Are you interested in accounting, controlling, manufacturing processes and understanding how product costs are built up? Then join our Product Costing & Inventory Valuation team. In this role, you develop expertise in Cost Accounting, Inventory Valuation and SAP S/4HANA processes while working closely with finance, controlling and operational teams worldwide.

- You support month-end and year-end closing activities, including Product Costing, Inventory Valuation and financial reporting processes.
- You analyze, validate and monitor standard and actual product costs in SAP, including the execution of product costing runs.
- Besides that, you investigate cost deviations, perform root cause analyses and collaborate with manufacturing, accounting and controlling teams to ensure accurate product cost calculations.
- In this role, you review, maintain and validate costing-relevant master data to ensure high data quality and accurate inventory valuation.
- Last but not least, you provide operational support for SAP S/4HANA Product Costing processes and contribute to process improvements, harmonization initiatives and automation projects.
- bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field
- first experience in accounting, cost accounting, inventory accounting, manufacturing finance or controlling, gained through internships, working student positions or initial professional roles
- good understanding of accounting principles, financial closing processes, cost accounting and inventory valuation, with a strong interest in manufacturing environments
- experience with SAP ERP, SAP CO, Product Costing, Material Ledger or SAP S/4HANA is an advantage
- structured and analytical way of working, strong attention to detail, and fluent English communication skills, additional European languages are a plus

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success
- 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options
- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs
- Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany - here a first impression
- Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks

HOW TO REACH US

title: Plant Manager - Marl (Werkleiter/in)
description:
Der Plant Manager ist für die Gesamtleitung von zwei Produktionsstandorten in Marl verantwortlich. Der Schwerpunkt der Position liegt auf Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, operativer Effizienz sowie der Koordination der Logistik.

Die Position umfasst die Steuerung des täglichen Betriebs und stellt gleichzeitig die Einhaltung der EHS-Vorschriften, Qualitätsstandards, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und Unternehmensrichtlinien sicher. Der Site Manager führt das Standortteam und treibt die kontinuierliche Verbesserung in den Bereichen Produktion, Qualität, Kosten und operative Leistungsfähigkeit voran.

Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller geltenden EHS-Gesetze und -Vorschriften sowie der internen Group-Richtlinien an den Produktionsstandorten.
- Verantwortung für Produktionsleistung, Produktqualität, Durchsatz und termingerechte Lieferungen.
- Planung und Überwachung der operativen Budgets sowie Sicherstellung einer effektiven Kostenkontrolle.
- Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse unter Anwendung von Lean-Manufacturing-Prinzipien.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller lokalen und unternehmensinternen EHS-Anforderungen, einschließlich Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und arbeitsmedizinischer bzw. arbeitshygienischer Programme.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Anforderungen hinsichtlich des sicheren Betriebs und der Instandhaltung von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.
- Abstimmung der Produktionskapazitäten und Personalplanung mit den Anforderungen der Logistik.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Anforderungen und Ziele gemäß ISO 9001, ISO 14001 und ISO 50001.
- Verbesserung von Qualität, Ausbeute, Durchsatz, Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Kosten durch kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und OPEX-Projekte.
- Identifizierung von Investitionsmöglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Anlageneffizienz und Ausbeute.
- Sicherstellung, dass die Produktionskosten innerhalb der genehmigten Budgets bleiben.
- Erstellung regelmäßiger Betriebs- und Leistungsberichte für den zuständigen Vorgesetzten, einschließlich: - Operative Leistungskennzahlen
- Qualität der Fertigprodukte in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung
- Wesentliche Produktions- und Kostenkennzahlen
- Sicherstellung einer effektiven Instandhaltung zur Minimierung von Stillstandszeiten und Maximierung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit.
- Führung, Entwicklung, Coaching und Motivation des Standortteams.
- Bearbeitung von Leistungs- und Verhaltensangelegenheiten bei Bedarf.
- Organisation und Überwachung der vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Bestandsaufnahmen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Logistik, Qualität, Instandhaltung, EHS, Finanzen und HR.
- Nationale und internationale Reisetätigkeit nach Bedarf (ca. 5 %).

Anforderungen:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Bergbau oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in einem produzierenden, industriellen, bergbaulichen oder vergleichbaren Produktionsumfeld.
- Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich der Betriebs- und Produktionsabläufe, einschließlich Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, Qualität, Prozesse, Instandhaltung und Investitionsprojekte (CapEx).
- Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams sowie im operativen Management.
- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Entscheidungs- und Problemlösungskompetenz.
- Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einem dynamischen und schnelllebigen Umfeld zu steuern.
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit.
- Ausgeprägter Fokus auf Sicherheit, Qualität, operative Exzellenz und Kundenanforderungen.
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

As a global organisation operating across multiple countries, compensation for this role may vary depending on location, local market benchmarks, and experience.
In line with our commitment to pay transparency, a salary range relevant to your location will be shared with you during the early stages of the recruitment process, before any interview is scheduled.

title: Hero Support Specialist (Assistent/in - Personalwesen)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Specialist, Hero Support to join the People & Culture team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

- Your Role: As a Specialist in Hero Support, you will play a key role in managing HR operations, optimizing employee lifecycle workflows, and ensuring smooth service delivery across DHSE Central. You'll bring a blend of strong operational expertise and a continuous improvement mindset to keep our processes efficient, compliant, and candidate- and employee-friendly.
- Operations & Case Management: Act as a primary operational contact for employee and manager queries via Jira, Slack, and email, independently resolving mixed-complexity tickets per month while maintaining >90% SLA adherence.
- End-to-End Lifecycle Operations: Execute employee lifecycle processes including employment contracts, amendments, probation management, transfers, and terminations, supporting a wide range of teams across the organization.
- Data Integrity & Compensation Administration: Maintain accurate employee records in Workday and support pre-payroll data reconciliation, one-time payments, and compensation updates with 95% accuracy and strong attention to compliance.
- Stakeholder Collaboration & Advisory: Apply working knowledge of German labor law and company policies to partner effectively with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Legal, and People Partners, serving as a trusted consultative advisor to managers and stakeholders across the business.
- Process Improvement & Automation: Identify operational bottlenecks and drive workflow enhancements in Workday and Jira, implementing process improvements per quarter to continuously elevate the employee experience.
- Knowledge Management: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and self-service Knowledge Base resources for employees and managers.
- Projects & Operational Excellence: Support cross-functional initiatives across HR compliance, process digitization, and audit readiness to enhance scalability and service quality.

Qualifications

- 1–3+ years of hands-on experience in HR Operations or People Operations, managing end-to-end employee lifecycle processes in a fast-paced environment.
- Solid understanding of German labor law, social security regulations, and general HR administrative compliance.
- Strong proficiency with modern HR systems, particularly Workday and ticketing platforms like Jira or ServiceNow.
- A customer-centric, empathetic mindset with a strong focus on high-quality service delivery.
- Strong detail orientation, problem-solving skills, and ability to prioritize in a dynamic workflow.
- Excellent communication skills in English (C1+) and strong working knowledge of German (B1+ minimum).
- Experience in global mobility operations and business travel administration is considered a strong plus.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading

delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

title: IT Project Manager (German-speaking), Matrix42, Espoo, Kuopio, Frankfurt
description:
About the role

As an IT Project Manager at Matrix42, you will be responsible for delivery projects related to Service Management (ITSM/ESM) and Identity Management (IAM/IGA) solutions. Your work will focus particularly on the German and Finnish markets and on successfully delivering projects related to public and private sector tenders. You will collaborate closely with sales, technical consultants, and clients to ensure successful project delivery and high customer satisfaction.

You can work in a hybrid model from the Espoo (Säteri), Kuopio, or Frankfurt office, and you enjoy meeting colleagues and customers face-to-face on a regular basis. The role requires occasional travel depending on project and customer needs.

You are offered:
- The opportunity to build your career in a growing international company
- A warm, low-hierarchy, people-centric work community where colleagues support each other and laughter is part of everyday life
- An agile growth company of the right size, without unnecessary bureaucracy, but with clear processes and strong development opportunities
- A working culture where humanity and well-being come first, while drive and high motivation are visible in everyday work

Work tasks

In your role as IT Project Manager, you will be fully responsible for planning, executing, and steering customer projects related to Service and Identity Management solutions. Your tasks include close collaboration with sales, technical experts, and customers, as well as managing project resources, time entries, and budget adherence.
- Lead end-to-end planning and execution of IT implementation and development projects
- Guide and coordinate technical consultants and the project team
- Monitor project resources, budgets, and schedules to ensure targets are met
- Conduct status meetings and report progress to steering groups and other stakeholders
- Ensure customer satisfaction and proactive communication throughout all project phases

We are looking for

- Strong experience leading IT projects in direct client-facing roles, ideally on the supplier side, acting as the primary point of contact between customer and delivery teams
- Fluent German and English skills, and Finnish language skills are an advantage
- Knowledge of different project management methodologies (e.g., Agile and Waterfall)
- Willingness to travel when required by projects
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills with various stakeholders

Experience with public sector tendering processes and working with public sector customers as well as delivering SaaS-based or platform solutions are seen as an addition asset.

To succeed in this role you are:
- Proactive and eager to learn – you adopt new knowledge quickly and boldly seize development opportunities
- Curious about change – you thrive in an environment where processes evolve, new people and products are introduced, and you can adapt your approach to different situations
- Natural organizer and bridge-builder – you guide both customers and project teams toward shared goals, collaborate smoothly with stakeholders, and communicate credibly even in demanding situations
- Service-minded and solution-oriented – you sense the dynamics of customer situations, identify opportunities to add value, and take responsibility for ensuring smooth progress for both the customer and your own organization

The role will later require passing a limited security clearance.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
description:
Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

Clearstream Fund Services is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the development and delivery of regulatory reporting solutions within the fund industry. The role focuses on key regulations such as PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, and the production of factsheets. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between business and technology, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and timely delivery of data products that meet regulatory requirements.
This position requires detailed domain knowledge of the funds industry and the associated regulatory regimes, strong ability to work autonomously, a good understanding of how managed services operate, fast-decision-making skills, a thinking-outside-the-box approach and strong stakeholder management skills.

Your responsibilities:

• Own the product lifecycle for chosen regulatory reporting solutions: from identifying opportunities, gathering requirements, and writing specifications for IT development, to deployment and operational readiness as a managed service.
• Ensure compliance and accuracy: translate regulatory obligations placed on our clients (e.g. PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD) into clear product requirements and maintain alignment with evolving rules.
• Bridge between business and IT: facilitate communication between clients, sales, operations, and technical teams to ensure shared understanding of goals and value to be created by our services.
• Enable technical delivery: collaborate with analysts, architects, and developers to design and implement robust data models and reporting solutions.
• Deliver full-stack reporting products: oversee both back-end processes (data ingestion, modeling) and front-end outputs (factsheets, disclosures, dashboards).
• Drive Agile practices: manage backlog, prioritize tasks based on regulatory deadlines and business needs, and contribute to sprint planning and iterative delivery.
• Document and communicate: produce clear requirements, user stories, and presentations of released solutions, and manage proactive communication with management.
• Act autonomously: make informed decisions, manage priorities, and ensure timely delivery without constant supervision.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
• 3-6 years of experience in the funds industry, with strong exposure to regulatory reporting regimes (e,g, PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD).
• Solid understanding of regulatory frameworks and their practical implications for data and reporting.
• Strong grasp of data ecosystems, software building skills and Agile methodologies.
• Knowledge of data quality, lineage, and governance practices.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of decisions.
• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

In case you are selected for an interview, you will be asked to present a case study that will be communicated to you in advance.

- Fluency in German and English is mandatory for stakeholder management
- Strong negotiation skills for managing sub-suppliers and the ability to thrive under the pressure of SOP deadline

You can expect ...

- Continuous salary development

- Appreciation, motivation and commitment

title: Pädagogische/r Mitarbeiter/in (m/w/d) im Betreuten Wohnen für junge Flüchtlinge (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description:
INSBI gGmbH / Institut für soziale und berufliche Integration gGmbH

Wir suchen:
Sozialarbeiter/in, Sozialpädagoge/in, Diplom/BA-Pädagoge/in, Erzieher/in (m/w/d)

Zu uns:
Die INSBI bietet betreutes Wohnen für unbegleitete minderjährige Flüchtlinge (UmF) ab 16 Jahren und für junge Volljährige an. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen einen sicheren und stabilen Lebensraum zu bieten, in dem sie Vertrauen, Orientierung und Perspektiven für ihre Zukunft entwickeln können.

In Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern und Bildungsträgern setzen wir uns für die gesellschaftliche und berufliche Integration junger Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ein. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf einem ressourcenorientierten Ansatz und folgt dem Prinzip des Empowerments: Wir begleiten die Jugendlichen individuell und stärken sie in ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung.

Besonders für junge Flüchtlinge, die oft traumatische Erlebnisse hinter sich haben, ist eine stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehung essenziell. Durch unser Bezugsbetreuersystem bieten wir Halt, Orientierung und fördern ihre Selbstständigkeit.

Mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung in der Jugendhilfe und Flüchtlingshilfe gestalten wir ein Umfeld, das Sicherheit, Schutz und eine realistische Zukunftsperspektive ermöglicht. Dabei legen wir Wert auf interkulturelle Sensibilität, Reflexion und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Akteuren, um den Jugendlichen bestmögliche Chancen zu bieten.

Darum geht's - Ihre Aufgaben
Als pädagogische/r Mitarbeiter/in in der ambulanten Betreuung im Betreuten Wohnen für minderjährige und junge volljährige Flüchtlinge übernehmen Sie unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:

- Anleitung und Unterstützung der jungen Menschen im lebenspraktischen Bereich, im Besonderen der Verselbstständigung in einer eigenen Wohnung oder WG.
- Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Abklärung asyl- und aufenthaltsrechtlicher Fragen und der Sicherstellung des Lebensunterhalts
- Einzelförderung im schulischen, beruflichen, sozial-emotionalen und gesundheitlichen Bereich sowie Freizeitgestaltung
- Krisenintervention
- Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern, Behörden, Rechtsanwältinnen, Schulen, Ausbilderinnen und Ärzt*innen
- Verwaltungstätigkeiten wie Dokumentation und Aktenführung
- Teilnahme an Teamsitzungen, Teamsupervision und Weiterbildungen.

Das bringen Sie mit - Ihr Profil

- Sie verfügen über eine Ausbildung/ein Studium zum/zur Sozialpädagoge/in oder Sozialarbeiter/in, Diplom/BA Pädagoge/in oder Erzieher/in oder sind Werksstudent/in und haben Freude an der Begleitung junger Menschen.
- Erfahrung in der pädagogischen Arbeit.
- Fähigkeit zur professionellen Beziehungsarbeit und die Bereitschaft zur kultursensiblen Arbeit.
- Kreativität, Flexibilität und Kooperationsfähigkeit.
- Freude an eigenständiger Arbeitsweise.

Unser Angebot - Ihre Vorteile

- Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit einer attraktiven Vergütung, die sich an der Berufsausbildung und der beruflichen Vorerfahrung orientiert.
- Attraktives Gleitzeitangebot.
- Fortlaufende Fachberatung und Supervision sowie Weiterbildungen.
- Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen.
- Ein engagiertes Team.
- Familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme mit den üblichen Bewerbungsunterlagen - gerne per Mail.

title: Häusliche / Ambulante Kinderkrankenpflege (Kinderkrankenschwester/-pfleger)
description:
Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt ausschließlich examinierte Gesundheits und Kinderkrankenpfleger/innen .

- regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
sowie regelmäßige Gruppen- und
Einzelsupervision
- ein ununbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis mit
verschiedenen Gehalts- und Arbeitszeitmodellen
- auf Wunsch ein Firmenfahrzeug auch zur privaten
Nutzung bzw. km Vergütung
- betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Herzlich Willkommen sind auch Pflegekräfte nach der Elternzeit mit zeitlich eingeschränkten Arbeitsmöglichkeiten.

Wir freuen uns, wenn wir Ihr Interesse geweckt haben. Wenn Sie Motivation, Sozialkompetenz und Freude am selbständigen Arbeiten mitbringen, freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung.

title: Hauswirtschaftskraft / Betreuungskraft (m/w/d) für unsere ambulant betreute Wohngemeinschaft (Hauswirtschafter/in)
description:
Für unsere ambulant betreute Wohngemeinschaft AhrLeben in Kalenborn suchen wir eine engagierte Hauswirtschaftskraft / Betreuungskraft (m/w/d).

Bei uns steht nicht der klassische Einrichtungsalltag im Mittelpunkt. Unsere Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner leben in einer familiären Wohngemeinschaft und gestalten ihren Alltag möglichst selbstbestimmt. Du unterstützt sie dabei, dass sich die WG wie ein echtes Zuhause anfühlt.

Deine Aufgaben

- Unterstützung bei der täglichen Haushaltsführung
- Einkaufen und Erledigung von Besorgungen
- Zubereitung von Mahlzeiten und gemeinsames Kochen
- Unterstützung bei der Wäschepflege
- Reinigung und Ordnung der gemeinschaftlich genutzten Bereiche

- Gemeinsame Spaziergänge und kleinere Aktivitäten

- Förderung sozialer Kontakte und der Gemeinschaft innerhalb der Wohngruppe
- Einbeziehung der Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner in alltägliche Tätigkeiten
- Gestaltung einer wohnlichen, wertschätzenden und familiären Atmosphäre
- Unterstützung bei Festen, Geburtstagen und gemeinschaftlichen Veranstaltungen
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Pflege- und Betreuungskräften

Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Aufgaben zu erledigen. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit den Bewohnerinnen und Bewohnern ihren Alltag und trägst dazu bei, dass die Wohngemeinschaft ein echtes Zuhause bleibt.

Das bringst du mit

- Freude an der Arbeit mit älteren und pflegebedürftigen Menschen
- Einfühlungsvermögen, Geduld und einen respektvollen Umgang
- Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
- Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
- Freude an hauswirtschaftlichen Tätigkeiten
- Kreativität und Bereitschaft, eigene Ideen einzubringen
- Teamfähigkeit und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Bereitschaft, auf individuelle Wünsche und Bedürfnisse der Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner einzugehen

Berufserfahrung im Bereich Hauswirtschaft, Betreuung oder Pflege ist von Vorteil, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Auch Quereinsteigerinnen und Quereinsteiger sind willkommen.

Das bieten wir dir

- Attraktive Vergütung
- Jährliche Sonderzahlungen
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Kranken- und Rentenzusatzversicherung
- 30 Tage Urlaub bei einer 5-Tage-Woche
- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
- Sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit langfristiger Perspektive
- Vollzeit, Teilzeit oder Minijob möglich
- Strukturierte und persönliche Einarbeitung
- Feste Ansprechpartner
- 100 % finanzierte Fort- und Weiterbildungen
- Ein wertschätzendes und familiäres Arbeitsumfeld
- Offene Kommunikation und kurze Entscheidungswege
- Raum für eigene Ideen und kreative Gestaltung
- Persönliche Beziehungen zu den Bewohnerinnen und Bewohnern
- Gemeinsame Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeiern sowie weitere Teamevents

Dein Arbeitsplatz

Die Wohngemeinschaft AhrLeben in Kalenborn bietet den Bewohnerinnen und Bewohnern ein familiäres Umfeld, in dem Gemeinschaft, Selbstbestimmung und individuelle Bedürfnisse im Mittelpunkt stehen. Schöner Leben verbindet dabei die Sicherheit professioneller Pflege mit der Atmosphäre eines privaten Zuhauses.

- Einfühlungsvermögen und Freude am Umgang mit älteren Menschen
- Ruhiges und besonnenes Auftreten
- Selbstständige Arbeitsweise

Quereinsteiger/innen, Studierende, Rentner/innen und Personen, die sich nebenberuflich engagieren möchten, sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Unser Ziel ist die Stabilisierung der Klienten. Wir wollen Krankenhausaufenthalte verkürzen oder vermeiden. Dafür suchen wir für unser neues Leistungsangebot der Ambulante Psychiatrische Pflege (APP) eine fachlich kompetente und empathische Führungskraft, welche bereits über eine Qualifikation als Pflegedienstleitung verfügt oder eine/n im Gesundheitsbereich bereits fachlich qualifizierte/n Mitarbeitende/n, welche die Qualifikation der Pflegedienstleitung erwirbt.

Ihre Aufgaben als PDL:

- Fachliche Leitung: Organisation und Steuerung des gesamten ambulant-psychiatrischen Pflegedienstes.
- Qualitätsmanagement: Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung der Pflegequalität nach gesetzlichen Vorgaben und MDK-Richtlinien.
- Personalführung: Dienstplanung, Teamentwicklung und fachliche Anleitung der Mitarbeitenden.
- Klientenmanagement: Durchführung von Erstgesprächen, Pflegeplanung und Steuerung des Pflegeprozesses.
- Netzwerkarbeit: Enge Kooperation mit Fachärzten, Kliniken, gesetzlichen Betreuern und Kostenträgern.

Ihr Profil

Sie sind: zuverlässig und belastbar, gehen auf Menschen zu und sind kommunikativ, verfügen über eine positive Grundhaltung, welche Akzeptanz und Empathie auch gegenüber – depressiven, antriebsschwachen oder suchtkranken Menschen beinhaltet, - arbeiten organisiert und scheuen es nicht Schriftverkehr zu führen, - verfügen über ein sicheres Deutsch und einen geschulten Umgang mit Word und Grundkenntnisse in Excel, im Umgang mit PCs und dem Versand von E-Mails.

- Grundqualifikation: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Pflegefachkraft (z. B. Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger/in, Altenpfleger/in).
- Zusatzqualifikation PDL (bei Anstellung oder durch Qualifikation im Rahmen der Beschäftigung): Anerguckte Weiterbildung zur Pflegedienstleitung oder ein entsprechendes Studium.
- Führungstalent: Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Organisationsgeschick und ein kooperativer Führungsstil.
- Führerschein: Führerschein der Klasse B ist für die ambulante Arbeit notwendig.

Wir bieten Ihnen

- Eine ausfüllende Tätigkeit, bei der Sie sich für Ihre Mitmenschen einsetzen können.
- Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (mindestens 30 Std.).
- Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach Absprache an Ihrer Lebenssituation orientieren. Maximal eine 5-Tage-Woche, nach Absprache auch weniger.
- Verzicht auf Schichtarbeit.
- Eine leistungsgerechte Entlohnung.
- Prämien, Boni und geldwerte Leistungen (Notebook, Handy) in Absprache.
- Die Möglichkeit eines Dienstrads, E-Bikes oder Dienstwagens, in Absprache auch zur privaten Nutzung.
- Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
- Fortbildungsangebote.
- Freiheiten, sich einzubringen und eigene Ideen umzusetzen.
- Innerbetriebliche Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen.
- Ein kollegiales Miteinander und ein nettes Team.

Ihre Bewerbung:

Ihre Bewerbung werden wir vertraulich behandeln.
Ihre Bewerbung senden Sie bitte ausschließlich per E-Mail an: bewerbung@nwnc.de

Bitte nennen Sie uns mit Ihrer Bewerbung den gewünschten zeitlichen Umfang Ihrer Tätigkeit, Ihre Gehaltsvorstellung (brutto) und den bevorzugten Standort für den Sie sich bewerben.

Bitte senden Sie uns mit Ihrer Bewerbung ein Anschreiben, einen Lebenslauf und einen vollständig ausgefüllten Bewerbungsbogen zu. Den Bewerbungsbogen können Sie hier herunterladen: http://nwnc.de/wp-content/uploads/Bewerbungsbogen.pdf

Vielen Dank.

title: Managementassistenz / Kaufmännische Fachkraft / Assistenz der Geschäftsleitung / Sozialmanagement (Managementassistent/in)
description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zur Unterstützung der Tätigkeit des operativen Tagesgeschäfts der Geschäftsleitung eine engagierte, fachlich versierte Unterstützung. Sie übernehmen koordinative Aufgaben, sind Ansprechpartner in betrieblichen Belangen und sorgen als unverzichtbare "rechte Hand" für die notwendige Entlastung.

Unsere Unternehmen unterhalten an diversen Standorten in Südniederachsen Hilfsangebote für Menschen, die ihren Alltagsverpflichtungen aus eigener Kraft vorübergehend nicht nachkommen können. Zweck der Gesellschaften ist die selbstlose Unterstützung von Personen, die in schwierigen Lebenslagen auf die Hilfe anderer angewiesen sind. Zur Verwirklichung dieses Zwecks erbringen wir Leistungen der Eingliederungshilfe, Hilfe in besonderen Lebenslagen, Schuldnerberatung und unterhalten Beschäftigungsprojekte. Wir unterstützen Menschen zur Sicherung des Lebensunterhalts und zur Befriedigung der Grundbedürfnisse (z.B. Nahrung, Kleidung, Bildung, Ausübung einer Tätigkeit, Mobilität, Freizeitgestaltung) und vermieten Wohnraum.

Wenn Sie sich auf eine Anstellung bewerben, besitzen Sie eine Ausbildung im Bereich Büro oder Verwaltung oder haben ein Studium abgeschlossen, welches Sie befähigt in diesen Bereichen zu arbeiten. Idealer Weise haben Sie durch eine vorherige Beschäftigung bereits fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Büroorganisation und -management erlangt und könnten nach Absprache selbständig Korrespondenz vorbereiten und führen. Zusätzliche Kenntnisse im Bereich Personal bzw. Buchhaltung wären von Vorteil.

Der zeitliche Umfang Ihrer Stelle erfolgt nach Vereinbarung. Der Stellenumfang sollte mindestens 30 Stunden/ Woche betragen. Ihre Zeiteinteilung ist, nach Absprache und zu vereinbarenden Präsenzzeiten flexibel.

Wir bieten Ihnen

- eine vielseitige Aufgabe in einer zukunftssicheren, wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe
- ein unbefristetes Beschäftigungsverhältnis in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit
- flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
- einen angenehmen, modernen Arbeitsplatz
- die Möglichkeit eigene Ideen einzubringen und eigenständig zu arbeiten
- flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
- eine angemessene Entlohnung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Jahressonderzahlungen
- nach Absprache die Übernahme von Kindesbetreuungskosten
- innerbetriebliche Entwicklungs-, Aufstiegschancen und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten
- im Laufe des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses Boni und Leistungsanreize durch die private Nutzung eines Dienstfahrrades, Dienstwagens, Diensthandys bzw. Dienstnotebooks
- einen kollegialen Umgang in einem netten Team.

Wir erwarten:

- Leistungsbereitschaft und -fähigkeit
- Zuverlässigkeit, Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit
- eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und positive Grundhaltung
- sicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift
- einen geschulten Umgang mit Word und Excel, mit PCs und sichere Kenntnisse der Internetrecherche und dem Versand von E-Mails und Kurznachrichten
- Loyalität und Verschwiegenheit.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Ihre Bewerbung werden wir vertraulich behandeln.

Mit der Bewerbung senden Sie uns bitte ein Anschreiben, einen Lebenslauf, Ihre Zeugnisse und einen Bewerbungsbogen (Link: https://nwnc.de/wp-content/uploads/Bewerbungsbogen_brutto.pdf), in welchem Sie uns Ihre Gehaltsvorstellung, den gewünschten zeitlichen Umfang Ihrer Tätigkeit und gewünschten Beginn Ihrer Tätigkeit nennen.

Ihre Bewerbung senden Sie bitte ausschließlich per E-Mail an: bewerbung@nwnc.de (https://mailto:bewerbung@nwnc.de)

Vielen Dank.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter / Payroll Specialist (m/w/d) ungarisch (Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter/in)
description:
Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter / Payroll Specialist (m/w/d)

Die europakraft GmbH ist eine Vermarktungsplattform für erstklassige Metallfachkräfte, freiberufliche Industriedienstleister (Freelancer) sowie Leiharbeitnehmer.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter / Payroll Specialist (m/w/d) für unsere Standorte Metzingen oder Budapest.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung der monatlichen Entgeltabrechnung unter Berücksichtigung gesetzlicher und betrieblicher Vorgaben
- Kompetenter Ansprechpartner für Krankenkassen, Sozialversicherungsträger und Behörden
- Aufbereitung, Prüfung und Abstimmung der Abrechnungsdaten sowie Durchführung der Gehaltsbuchungen und Mitwirkung bei Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen
- Pflege der Stamm-, Zeit- und Bewegungsdaten im Abrechnungssystem zvoove (ehemals Landwehr)

Ihr Profil

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Entgeltabrechnung
- Gute Kenntnisse im Arbeits-, Lohnsteuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht
- Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit dem Personal- und Entgeltabrechnungssystem zvoove (ehemals Landwehr)
- Ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung, Eigeninitiative sowie eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
- Teamfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Belastbarkeit

Unser Angebot

- Sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit unbefristetem Arbeitsvertrag
- Laptop auch zur privaten Nutzung
- Zeitweise Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
- Interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem wachsenden Unternehmen
- Angenehmes Arbeitsklima und kollegiales Team
- Attraktive, leistungsgerechte Vergütung

title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen

- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Ungarns

- Spannende Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung

Seit 1987 sind wir löwenstark am Markt – innovativ, familiär und zukunftsorientiert.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Assistant driller
description:
Seeking an assistant driller

Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.

Key Responsibilities:
• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.
• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.
• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.
• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.
• Assisting with cementing.
• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).
• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:
• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Experience with Drillmec or Bentec rigs strongly preferred. Experince as Derrickman. 2 years minimum Assistant Driller experience highly preferred.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and initiative, fluency in English. Good experince operating powertools.
• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.
• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.
• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.

Employer can assist with housing.

Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.
Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.

Please apply by sending your application and CV to: jons@jardboranir.is.
Last application date is October 31, 2026.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Graphics Programmer
description:
CCP is looking for a Graphics Programmer with a deep passion for games and visual craft to join the EVE Online art team in our Reykjavík studio.

You will work closely with artists and engineers to bring stunning visuals to life, developing shaders, rendering features, and tools that directly shape the look and feel of EVE Online.

The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.

Your Tasks:
Design and implement new graphical features, shaders, and visual solutions that enhance EVE Online’s signature look.
Work closely with artists to understand their needs and deliver tools and workflows that empower their creativity.
Contribute to improvements in real-time rendering quality and visual performance.
Identify and resolve graphics performance issues in collaboration with the team.
Deliver new features and improve existing visual systems, prioritizing and breaking down tasks to meet deadlines.
Help maintain a collaborative and supportive team environment.

Your Profile:
2-3 years of experience in graphics programming, technical art or a related field.
Experience with real-time graphics programming and an understanding of modern rendering pipelines.
Hands-on experience with shader programming (HLSL or GLSL).
Experience with Python. Knowledge of C++ is a plus.
Experience or strong interest in developing internal tools and pipeline automation to support artists.
Familiarity with GPU profiling and performance optimization.
Strong communication skills. You’re comfortable bridging the gap between technical and artistic disciplines.
Passionate about EVE Online’s unique universe and the challenge of making it look extraordinary.

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.

title: Lead Game Designer
description:
CCP Games is seeking a Lead Game Designer to help our EVE Online design team grow, align, and deliver impactful gameplay and system as we build EVE into its third decade.

This is primarily a leadership role. While design judgment is essential, your greatest impact will come from mentorship, communication, and enabling designers to do their best work within complex, long-running live systems.

What You'll Do:
Lead, mentor, and support senior designers, with a focus on growth, feedback, and long-term career development
Improve team effectiveness by strengthening communication, collaboration, and clarity across disciplines
Partner with the Game Design Director to evolve and uphold EVE Online’s design process
Guide feature teams through exploration and development, encouraging a solution-oriented mindset while preserving momentum
Foster a culture of empowerment, experimentation, and learning within a live service environment
Identify and address team health issues early, helping teams navigate alignment challenges
Act as a trusted design leader for stakeholders, aligning goals and constraints into shared understanding

What We're Looking For:
6+ years of game design experience, including 2+ years in a people-focused leadership role
Proven ability to mentor and grow experienced designers
Extensive experience with gameplay systems and live game design, with the ability to give high-quality feedback
Clear, empathetic communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills
Experience shipping features in live service, MMO, sandbox, or similarly complex products
A leadership mindset focused on enabling others and team outcomes, not individual ownership
Bonus Experience: Familiarity with EVE Online, sandbox games, or player-driven economies

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

Formazione teorica e pratica fornita da esperti del settore; Opportunità di apprendere e lavorare in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo; Possibilità di assunzione stabile presso l'azienda al completamento del percorso formativo previa valutazione positiva del percorso; La ricerca è rivolta a Candidati/e di età compresa tra 18-24 anni, in possesso di Diploma di Istruzione Secondaria Superiore Superiore o del quarto anno di IeFP di tipo Tecnico. title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per azienda cliente leader nel settore impermeabilizzazione di strutture selezioniamo: TECNICO COMMERCIALE AREA EMILIA_AMBITO CIVILE/EDILE Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nella rete commerciale e lavorando a stretto contatto con Area Manager e agenti di zona, sarai un punto di riferimento tecnico per progettisti, imprese e installatori, con un ruolo dinamico tra ufficio e cantiere. In particolare, sarai specialista nel fornire soluzioni tecnico-commerciali presso clientela B2B (studi di progettazione, imprese, installatori e distributori): - supporterai il team commerciale nella definizione della proposta tecnica e tramite sopralluoghi operativi in cantiere - gestirai incontri tecnici e formativi rivolti a progettisti e installatori per diffondere competenze applicative e qualità esecutiva - implementerai nuove relazioni sul territorio e contribuirai all'inserimento delle soluzioni nei capitolati Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - formazione in ambito edile/civile (Ingegneria Edile/Civile, Architettura/Geometra) - esperienza in ruoli tecnico-commerciali nel settore edile (o contesti affini) - dimestichezza con AutoCAD e Office 365 - conoscenza della lingua inglese intermedia - ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, orientamento agli obiettivi e curiosità professionale - disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio (ruolo in mobilità nell'area Emilia Romagna) Orario di lavoro: full time, dal lunedì al venerdì (attività prevalentemente sul territorio con flessibilità operativa e possibilità di smart working). Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto di assunzione diretta a tempo indeterminato per figure middle/senior nel ruolo, mentre con risorse entry level è previsto un apprendistato professionalizzante finalizzato all'indeterminato CCNL applicato: Industria calce, cemento e gesso La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 36.000 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Sono inoltre previsti auto ad uso promiscuo, PC e telefono aziendale, incentivi legati ai risultati. Prevista formazione iniziale con training 1-2 settimane presso l'HQ in provincia di Treviso. Luogo di lavoro: Emilia-Romagna (ruolo in mobilità: smart working + presidio presso Clienti e cantieri nell'area) - base preferibile Bologna Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! *Grafton Engineering è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: ispettore di pesi e misure/ispettrice di pesi e misure
description: La Divisione Permanent di Gi Group (Aut. Min. 26/11/04 Prot. n. 1101-SG), con un team di consulenti dedicati, si occupa della ricerca e selezione di risorse con esperienza, che hanno voglia di intraprendere nuovi percorsi professionali. I nostri consulenti ti aiuteranno a trovare la migliore opportunità lavorativa, grazie ad un'attenta analisi delle tue competenze e delle tue esperienze. Per solida azienda del settore impianti tecnologici, siamo alla ricerca di un/a FACILITY SPECIALIST Principali responsabilità Il Facility Specialist verrà inserito all'interno di un team e si occuperà delle seguenti attività: Pianificare e supervisionare la manutenzione ordinaria, straordinaria e preventiva degli impianti tecnologici (elettrici, idraulici, condizionamento). Interfacciarsi quotidianamente con i committenti per pianificare gli interventi Supervisionare da remoto le squadre operative on-site, garantendo l'efficienza degli interventi e il rispetto delle tempistiche contrattuali. Redigere report periodici sull'andamento delle attività e interfacciarsi con il committente per aggiornamenti. Gestire eventuali criticità operative e interventi di emergenza, assicurando la continuità del servizio. Si occupa di rifornire le attrezzature per la manutenzione provvedendo all'acquisto dei materiali. Requisiti Esperienza nel ruolo di facility specialist o nel coordinamento di attività legate a manutenzioni in ambito idraulico, edile ed elettrico Diploma o Laurea Conoscenza degli impianti tecnologici Spiccate capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione con clienti, fornitori e team interni.
