description:
Postulation : https://www.jobup.ch/en/jobs/detail/b2dabcb5-de1a-49d7-870d-91c536ce96a7/?source=company_detail

Are you passionate about creating seamless experiences in education and sport? Are you sensitive to serving the
athletes and bringing them at the center of the sport ecosystem ?
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?
Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?
Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping
the future of sports leadership.
About AISTS
AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not-for-profit academic
centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it offers world-class
education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary approach combines
expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership. With a network of over 750
alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport organisations, AISTS shapes the future of
international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting
excellence in sport management to drive positive global impact through the power of sport.
Your role
The Product Portfolio Senior Manager is responsible for translating the AISTS portfolio strategy into a coherent,
prioritised and commercially viable product portfolio across three product areas: Education, Athletes Pathways, and
Advisory. It initially owns direct responsibility for both Education and Athletes Pathways products streams.
The role ensures that AISTS moves from a primarily MAS-centred organisation toward an integrated platform
combining industry access, short and tailored education, athlete-career transition solutions, and international sport
organisations advisory services (e.g. impact assessments, certification, research mandates, etc.).
Positioning & Context
Reporting to the Executive Director, you will work in partnership with the Professors, experts, speakers and partners
of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the Head of B2B Partnerships & Development and the
Head of Operations & Delivery. Initially, you will manage the Sport Advisory Product Coordinator.
This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role may evolve
according to the deployment of the strategy.
Key responsibilities
Portfolio Management
• Own the consolidated product portfolio roadmap across Education, Athletes Pathways and Advisory.
• Establish common product management standards and coherence across products in terms of target
audiences, value propositions, pricing logic, delivery model, resource needs and expected contribution.

Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping

About AISTS
AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not-for-profit
academic centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it
offers world-class education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary
approach combines expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership.
With a network of over 750 alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport
organisations, AISTS shapes the future of international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves
as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting excellence in sport management to drive
positive global impact through the power of sport.
Your role
The Product Coordinator – Sport Advisroy is responsible for building AISTS sport advisory – such as
impact assessment, sport equipment certification, etc. – into clear, market-facing products with
scientifically-rigorous methodologies and lean delivery models. The role covers two main product
families: impact assessments and analysis for sport events and organisations; and sport equipment
compliance/certification services for key sport equipment stakeholders (rule-makers, designers,
producers, users…).

and researchers of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the B2B Development &
Marketing team and the Operations & Delivery team.
This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role
may evolve according to the deployment of the strategy.

title: Truck Racing and Historic Sporting Coordinator
description:
The Truck Racing and Historic Sporting Coordinator will contribute to the sporting, regulatory and operational delivery of the FIA Truck Racing and Historic Championships. The position is intended for a confirmed sporting coordination profile, capable of managing day-to-day championship matters with a high level of autonomy, while ensuring appropriate escalation and validation on regulatory, sporting and governance matters.

The role requires practical on-site experience, regular interaction with Race Control, Stewards, Race Directors, officials and teams, and the ability to distinguish between matters to be managed independently, matters to be prepared for validation, and matters to be performed under the authority of the relevant sporting decision-makers.

The indicative workload allocation is expected to be:
Truck Racing: 60%
Historic Championships: 40%

MISSIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
TRUCK RACING CHAMPIONSHIP SPORTING COORDINATION :
Coordinate the day-to-day sporting administration of the Truck Racing Championship, ensuring compliance with FIA requirements, sporting regulations and established procedures.
Manage the championship entry process and entry platform where applicable, including competitor support, document follow-up and deadline monitoring.
Review entry documentation and prepare any non-standard or eligibility-related matters for validation by the relevant Championship Manager or competent FIA body.
Coordinate routine communications with teams, ASNs, officials and internal FIA departments on sporting and operational matters.

HISTORIC CHAMPIONSHIPS SPORTING COORDINATION :
Coordinate day-to-day sporting and administrative matters related to Historic Championships, in liaison with the Historic Championships & Commission Manager.
Prepare sporting documents, procedures and information notes for review and validation by the relevant manager or governance body.
Follow up championship-related actions, regulatory updates and stakeholder requests.
Ensure proper coordination between Historic championship activities, commission work and FIA internal processes.

SPORTING DOCUMENTATION :
Prepare, review and maintain sporting documents for events and championships, including procedures, notes to competitors, operational guidelines and Stewards' Handbooks.
Ensure sporting documents remain aligned with current FIA regulations, championship requirements and operational practices.
Prepare draft amendments or updates for validation by the relevant Championship Manager and, where applicable, FIA governance bodies.
Coordinate the circulation of validated documents to the relevant internal and external stakeholders.

ON-SITE EVENT OPERATIONS AND RACE CONTROL SUPPORT

Race Control and Stewards support :
Support the Race Director and Race Control team during events, including preparation and coordination of operational procedures, messaging systems, radio communications, incident follow-up and parc fermé processes.
Prepare Race Control documentation, checklists and briefing materials in advance of events.
Assist the Stewards during events by coordinating administrative and operational processes, including official documentation, communication flows and distribution of decisions.
Prepare incident-related documentation or reports for review by the Race Director or Stewards, without substituting for their sporting decision-making authority.
Operate FIA onboard camera systems and retrieve footage when requested by the Race Director or Stewards for sporting or regulatory purposes.

Commission, committee and stakeholder coordination :
Attend meetings of the Truck Racing Commission, Historic Commission and related working groups as Sporting Coordinator.
Prepare agendas, working documents, meeting dossiers and follow-up notes for review and validation where required.
Maintain records of commission activities, recommendations and decisions.
Follow up action items resulting from commission meetings and coordinate with relevant FIA departments or stakeholders.
Escalate sensitive, strategic or policy-related matters to the relevant Championship Manager or Head of Racing & Historic.

Operational and administrative coordination :
Coordinate the operational needs of FIA staff on-site in relation to Truck Racing and Historic activities.
Support implementation of FIA sporting requirements during events.
Ensure effective preparation, follow-up and filing of sporting and operational documentation.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of sporting and operational processes within the scope of the role.

PROFILE:
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in motorsport sporting operations, championship coordination, race administration or equivalent.
Proven practical on-site experience and regular interaction with Race Control, Stewards, Race Directors, officials, teams and championship stakeholders.
Strong understanding of motorsport sporting regulations, event operations and regulatory processes.
Ability to work autonomously, manage priorities and identify matters requiring validation or escalation.
Strong organisational, drafting and communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear sporting and operational documentation.
Ability to work under pressure in an event environment and to interact professionally with officials, competitors and internal departments.
Fluent in English; French would be an advantage.
Available from December 2026.

Un.e éducateur/trice diplômé\-e à 80% en CDI
================================================







Déployée sur plusieurs sites, l'Institution de Lavigny est constituée d’un hôpital neurologique avec consultations ambulatoires sur deux sites, d’un département hébergement pour personnes adultes en situation de handicap, avec une déficience intellectuelle ou une problématique physique, d’une école spécialisée et d’un secteur ateliers et formation professionnelle.



Le département de l’école spécialisée « La Passerelle », accueille des enfants de 6 à 18 ans en difficulté d’apprentissage et de développement. Il assure un accompagnement global de l’enfant comprenant une formation scolaire, des interventions et suivis thérapeutiques et un suivi éducatif, avec possibilité d’hébergement de semaine et des temps d’accueil parascolaire. **Pour notre hébergement de semaine** qui accueille 14 jeunes en âge de scolarité, et **notre secteur** **parascolaire** nous cherchons :







Un.e éducateur/trice diplômé\-e à 80% en CDI
================================================



Dont la mission principale consistera à proposer un accompagnement éducatif aux enfants/adolescents, favorisant le lien entre la vie scolaire, les temps de loisirs et la vie de famille. L’activité se partage entre un accompagnement en hébergement de semaine et l’animation d’activités parascolaires (sports, devoirs, activités culturelles, etc.).



En étroite collaboration avec les familles et le réseau professionnel, vous contribuerez à l’élaboration et à la mise en œuvre d’un projet individualisé et adapté à chaque jeune, dans le cadre d’une intervention visant l’apprentissage de l’autonomie, l’autodétermination et qui s’appuie sur les ressources et les compétences des jeunes et de leurs familles.



En tant que personne expérimentée, à même de gérer des projets, vous saurez proposer des activités ludiques et épanouissantes, qu’elles soient groupales ou individuelles. Vous saurez mettre en perspective et en réflexion une approche systémique et pluridisciplinaire basée sur le respect de la responsabilité, de l’autonomie et de la vulnérabilité de chacun. Dynamique, communicateur, vous possédez un intérêt marqué pour le travail en équipe interdisciplinaire.



Les horaires de travail sont annualisés et se répartissent de 7 à 22h, du lundi midi au vendredi midi. Les services sont fermés pendant les vacances scolaires vaudoises.



**Nous demandons** :



* Un diplôme d’éducateur social ES ou HES reconnu,  
* Un permis de conduire valable,  
* Un intérêt prononcé pour le domaine de la pédagogie spécialisée et des troubles des apprentissages,  


**Nous offrons :**



* Une activité au sein d’une équipe dynamique et motivée, dans un cadre de travail agréable,  
* Un salaire en rapport avec la fonction et selon les normes du secteur parapublic vaudois,  
* Des possibilités de formation continue,  
* Les avantages sociaux d’une grande institution, restaurant, parking ou transports publics assurés depuis la gare de Morges.

Business Manager (w/m/d)
========================











Über uns
---------







LGT ist eine führende internationale Private Banking und Asset Management Gruppe, die sich seit über 100 Jahren im Besitz der Fürstenfamilie von Liechtenstein befindet. Mit rund 600 Mitarbeitenden hat sich die LGT Bank Schweiz als namhafte Schweizer Privatbank etabliert und ist sowohl für vermögende Privatkunden wie auch für Mitarbeitende eine ausgezeichnete Adresse \- dies bestätigte im vergangenen Jahr auch das unabhängige Institut «Great Place To Work», welches die LGT Bank Schweiz als einer der besten Arbeitgeber in der Schweiz prämiert hat.

------------------







Für unser Team suchen wir eine engagierte und motivierte Persönlichkeit als Business Manager. In dieser vielseitigen erwarten Sie folgende Aufgaben:  




* Vorbereitung und Koordination von Managementsitzungen, Workshops, Offsites und Leadership Events, einschliesslich der Erstellung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Präsentationen, Berichten und Kernbotschaften für die Geschäftsleitung

* Koordination und Abstimmung mit relevanten Anspruchsgruppen sowie Sicherstellung einer transparenten und konsistenten Kommunikation und Umsetzung.

unbefristet

**Entdecke deine Vorteile**



**Aus\- und Weiterbildung**  
Wir investieren in die Entwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden. Ein breites internes Bildungsangebot steht allen offen, und wir unterstützen externe Weiterbildungen.  
**Attraktive Ferienregelung**  
Unsere Ferienregelung garantiert allen Mitarbeitenden mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien. Ab dem 50\. Lebensjahr sind es 6 Wochen und ab dem 60\. Lebensjahr sogar 7 Wochen. Zudem ist der Kauf von weiteren Ferientagen möglich.  
**Familienzeit**  
Mütter erhalten während der 18 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub 100 Prozent ihres versicherten Lohns. Der andere Elternteil geniesst 3 Wochen Familienzeit bei vollem Lohn.  
**Versicherungsleistungen**  
Wir sichern unsere Mitarbeitenden mit überdurchschnittlichen Sozial\- und Vorsorgeleistungen ab und bieten Sonderkonditionen auf Zusatzversicherungen bei diversen Krankenkassen für ihre gesamte Familie.  
**Vergünstigungen und Rabatte**  
Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren unter anderem von Rabatten beim Einkaufen und Tanken, von Gutschriften auf REKA\-Geld sowie vergünstigten Mobile\-Abos für sie und ihre Familien.  
  



**Unser Bewerbungsprozess**



Die Bewerbung läuft ganz einfach über das Online\-Formular – eine Eingangsbestätigung folgt automatisch.



Nach sorgfältiger Durchsicht aller Unterlagen gibt's eine Rückmeldung, sobald die Vorauswahl steht.



Gratulation! Das Dossier hat überzeugt und wir lernen uns bei ein oder zwei Gesprächen persönlich kennen.



Passt es für beide Seiten, folgt ein verbindliches Angebot.



Danach heisst es: Willkommen im Team und auf eine gute gemeinsame Zeit!



**Über uns**



Die LANDI Schweiz AG ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der fenaco\-Genossenschaft und verantwortet den Erfolg der LANDI Läden in der ganzen Schweiz. Sie steuert die Sortimentsplanung, Markenpositionierung und Verkaufsförderung, koordiniert Neu\- und Umbauten und schult die Mitarbeitenden der LANDI Läden. Gleichzeitig übernimmt sie die gesamte Logistik, von Beschaffung über Lagerung bis zur Kommissionierung. Das Sortiment umfasst Garten\-, Kleintier\-, Haushalts\-, Do\-it\-yourself\-, Landwirtschaft\- und Freizeitartikel sowie Getränke und Pet\-Food.

title: Strategic Account Manager Orthopaedics (Open)
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more athttps://www.jnj.com/.



About Orthopaedics

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech



Strategic Account Manager Orthopaedics - Johnson & Johnson

Western Part of Switzerland

Are you passionate about making a tangible difference in healthcare? Do you thrive on building strong relationships and driving growth? We are seeking a Senior Strategic Account Manager to join our sales team, drive market expansion, and deliver innovative surgical solutions to our customers. This role anchors Johnson & Johnson’s go-to-market strategy, emphasizing long-term partnerships and measurable value for patients. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to elevate customer outcomes and fuel sustainable business growth. If you’re a strategic thinker with a proven track record in key account management, we’d love to hear from you.



Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management is an essential part of the future business strategy for the Johnson & Johnson companies. It is how we will go to market as an Orthopaedics organization and will be critical to our future growth plans. With this approach to our non-clinical customers, we can demonstrate the long-term value of partnership and working with Johnson & Johnson, most importantly, our impact on patient care.

In the role as Strategic Account Manager you will report to the Lead of the Strategic Account Management for Orthopaedics and be responsible for developing mutually beneficial long-term partnerships with clinical and non-clinical partners in a given number of designated key accounts.

In conjunction with the Business Units, you will develop and lead the account strategy to drive additional profitable sales and market share growth within Hospital, Hospital Groups & Group Purchasing Organizations.

Together with the clinical team, you will coordinate and support the proposal development process, presenting opportunities and risks along with their implications to the required levels of management.

As key driver of our Value Based Health Care Strategy you will lead negotiations for commercial agreements and coordinate their execution across care centers, in collaboration with the Business Unit and Shared Functions (Pricing, Services & Solutions, HEMA, etc.).

You will be the representative of Johnson & Johnson Orthopaedics for the commercial partners in strategic accounts.



Qualifications

Master’s degree in Business Administration or relevant field is an advantage.

Several years of clinical experience in a Sales Manager or Key Account Manager role, with proven experience in managing non-clinical partnerships.

Deep understanding of the healthcare market and the local regulatory/policy environment; adept at identifying short-term and long-term factors impacting the business.

Experience in contract negotiations and deal structuring.

Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in French to professionally represent Johnson & Johnson’s MedTech in the country; strong English skills (written and spoken) are required; proficiency in a second official language is preferred.

German language skills in writing and speaking are a plus.

Strong negotiation skills, high self-confidence, courage, and conviction.

Analytical and strategic thinker with solid business acumen.

Project management capabilities with the ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset.



Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone Orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 4 to 9 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.

Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans.In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

This role is the foundation of Accelleron's new Advanced Analytics AI Center of Excellence. This role requires coding experience and handling of structured and unstructured data sets. This role transforms business challenges into data-driven solutions: identifying the right data, building and validating models, translating results into insights and measurable business value.



The Advanced Analytics AI CoE builds process-agnostic capability and acts as the expert partner to the process domain teams and business units that own the solutions. Alongside hands-on delivery, the role helps the AI citizen program across the company to work safely and effectively with AI. These roles will help to go up to the next AI data maturity level.



**Your Responsibilities:**



AI and machine-learning use case delivery

Support and deliver data driven solutions: from problem framing and feasibility assessment to model development, validation, deployment, and post-go-live monitoring.
Create actionable insights using data science & AI methods: statistical analysis, machine learning, computer vision, Large Language Models applied to business problems.
Solution Hand over to sustainable operation: documentation, retraining and monitoring approach, and clear ownership together with the process domain and application teams.


**Business partnership & value translation**

Work with business units to understand their needs: engage with Divisions & Functions, clarify the actual process to be improved, and challenge when required.
Translate analytical results into business value and actions: explain findings in business language, quantify the expected benefits, and define what should change as a result.
Advise business users end to end: from data inputs, feature selection, modelling approaches, evaluation of results, and practical project implementation.
Contribute to use case qualification: assess data availability and quality, effort, risk and expected return, and support the demand intake and prioritization process. It should follow the regulations in place (e.g EU AI Act, GDPR) and internal processes (e.g Security).


**Data sourcing & platform collaboration**

Identify and source relevant data: locate the right internal and external data, assess its quality, ownership and suitability, and prepare it for analytical use.
Work through the Enterprise Data Layer and Data Product Catalogue: consume governed data products when they exist, feed gaps back to the Enterprise Data Architect and data-product owners rather than building one-off extracts (Create once, deploy multiple times).

Work through the Enterprise Data Layer and Data Product Catalogue: consume governed data products when they exist, feed gaps back to the Enterprise Data Architect and data-product owners rather than building one-off extracts (Create once, deploy multiple times).


**Tooling, engineering & standards**

Integrate tools such as Python and R into the analytics landscape incl. notebooks, libraries, and their use within Microsoft Fabric and the enterprise data platform.
Apply sound data engineering practices: version control, code review, environment management, testing, and repeatable pipelines for data preparation and model training.
Help define the CoE's methods and standards: reference approaches, templates, model documentation, evaluation criteria, and the path from prototype to production.
Evaluate new methods and tools: assess their fit for Accelleron and make pragmatic recommendations on what to adopt.


**Enablement of citizen data scientists & knowledge sharing**

Enable AI citizen: provide guardrails, templates, training and coaching so business users can apply advanced analytics safely and effectively.
Advise the citizen community on method choice: when self-service analytics is appropriate, when a CoE-delivered solution is the better answer, and where the risks lie.
Share best practices and collaborate across Digital and IS teams incl.the MS Copilot Studio CoE, process engineers, application owners, and the Digital AI team, to reuse assets rather than duplicate capability.
Contribute to communities of practice to raise AI & data literacy across the organization.

**How success is measured:**

Data Science & AI use cases delivered into production, with demonstrable business value.
Models that are documented, monitored, and maintainable beyond their original author.
Analytical solutions built on governed data products rather than bespoke one-off.
A growing, capable and well-governed AI citizen community.
Reusable methods, templates and assets shared across the CoEs and IS teams.
Positive feedback from business stakeholders on the usefulness of results.

**Experience**

Practical experience delivering data science and AI solutions in a business context, ideally in an international industrial environment.
Track record of taking analytical work from exploration through to productive use.
Experience advising or coaching non-specialist users is an advantage.

**Technical expertise**

Strong command of Python and/or R and the common data science libraries; solid SQL.
Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning — supervised and unsupervised methods, forecasting, model evaluation and validation (Data science and AI).
Experience with cloud analytics platforms, ideally Microsoft Fabric / Azure AI, and with Data Lakehouse and data-pipeline concepts.

Preferably. Knowledge on computer vision (manufacturing processes) and LLM.

Genuine curiosity about the business problem, not only the method.

Collaborative, willing to share knowledge and to work in cross-functional fusion teams.

*  **French is highly desirable** and will be considered a strong asset.

The Opportunity

This is a **permanent position offering 100% remote work**, with the opportunity to combine **science, technology and sales** in a highly specialized Life Sciences environment.

description:
Are you passionate about challenging the status\-quo in sport?

Do you value research\-driven and scientifically rigourous solutions?

Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?

Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping the future of sports leadership.

About AISTS

AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not\-for\-profit academic centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it offers world\-class education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary approach combines expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership. With a network of over 750 alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport organisations, AISTS shapes the future of international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting excellence in sport management to drive positive global impact through the power of sport.

Your role

The Product Coordinator – Sport Advisroy is responsible for building AISTS sport advisory – such as impact assessment, sport equipment certification, etc. – into clear, market\-facing products with scientifically\-rigorous methodologies and lean delivery models. The role covers two main product families: impact assessments and analysis for sport events and organisations; and sport equipment compliance/certification services for key sport equipment stakeholders (rule\-makers, designers, producers, users…).

Positioning \& Context

Reporting into the Product Portfolio Senior Manager, you will work in partnership with the Professors and researchers of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the B2B Development \& Marketing team and the Operations \& Delivery team.

This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role may evolve according to the deployment of the strategy.

Key responsibilities

**Product development**

* Transform AISTS globally recognised assessment methodologies into clear, repeatable and cost\-efficient products while preserving its core characteristics: scientifically rigorous and pragmatic for industry application, incl.:


\-\> standardised impact assessment products with economic impact as a core entry point and extensions into environmental, social \& media and stakeholder/community\-relevant impacts

\-\> independent sport equipment regulation assessment and certification processes to support key sport stakeholders – federations, event organisers, manufacturers and athletes – in guaranteeing a level\-playing field companies in designing, assessing and certifying processes, operational frameworks and quality standards.

\-\> Develop sample outputs, case references and marketing\-ready value propositions for IFs, event organisers, cities, hosts, sponsors and sport organisations.

* Create a leaner operational model that combines AISTS quality assurance with external experts, academic partners and delivery coordinators where appropriate:


\-\> Define product formats, methodology templates, data needs, deliverables, pricing logic, timelines and delivery roles.

\-\> Define what AISTS can credibly own directly versus what requires technical, legal, engineering or standards partners.

\-\> Establish quality assurance principles, methodology governance and documentation standards to protect AISTS credibility.

* Explore opportunities of application of existing products into other fields such as sport venues and infrastructures, innovation with new materials, compliance with emerging standards and certification, etc.


**Commercial packaging and performance, governance and continuous improvement**

* Work with the B2B Development \& Marketing team to:


\-\> identify priority clients and opportunities, including IFs, event organisers, brands, technology providers and venues.

\-\> translate technical products into simple commercial materials, one\-pagers, case studies and pitch narratives.

* Create product pricing and effort models that improve profitability compared with bespoke one\-off projects
* Track project outcomes, client satisfaction, methodology improvements, cost of delivery and repeatability.
* Build a database of assessments and findings over time to enable benchmarking, recurring diagnostics and future thought leadership.


What we offer

**Dynamic Work Environment:** Join an international team passionate about sports and education.

title: Sport Advisory Product Coordinator
employer: Académie Internationale des Sciences et Techniques du Sport (AISTS)
description:
Postulation : https://www.jobup.ch/en/jobs/detail/16ecfd73-10cb-4260-922f-0ac4003adcfd/?source=company_detail

Are you passionate about challenging the status-quo in sport?
Do you value research-driven and scientifically rigourous solutions?
Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?
Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping
the future of sports leadership.
About AISTS
AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not-for-profit
academic centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it
offers world-class education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary
approach combines expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership.
With a network of over 750 alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport
organisations, AISTS shapes the future of international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves
as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting excellence in sport management to drive
positive global impact through the power of sport.
Your role
The Product Coordinator – Sport Advisroy is responsible for building AISTS sport advisory – such as
impact assessment, sport equipment certification, etc. – into clear, market-facing products with
scientifically-rigorous methodologies and lean delivery models. The role covers two main product
families: impact assessments and analysis for sport events and organisations; and sport equipment
compliance/certification services for key sport equipment stakeholders (rule-makers, designers,
producers, users…).
Positioning & Context
Reporting into the Product Portfolio Senior Manager, you will work in partnership with the Professors
and researchers of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the B2B Development &
Marketing team and the Operations & Delivery team.
This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role
may evolve according to the deployment of the strategy.
Key responsibilities
Product development
• Transform AISTS globally recognised assessment methodologies into clear, repeatable and costefficient
products while preserving its core characteristics: scientifically rigorous and pragmatic for
industry application, incl.:
o standardised impact assessment products with economic impact as a core entry point and
extensions into environmental, social & media and stakeholder/community-relevant impacts
o independent sport equipment regulation assessment and certification processes to support
key sport stakeholders – federations, event organisers, manufacturers and athletes – in
guaranteeing a level-playing field companies in designing, assessing and certifying
processes, operational frameworks and quality standards.
o Develop sample outputs, case references and marketing-ready value propositions for IFs,
event organisers, cities, hosts, sponsors and sport organisations.
• Create a leaner operational model that combines AISTS quality assurance with external experts,
academic partners and delivery coordinators where appropriate:
o Define product formats, methodology templates, data needs, deliverables, pricing logic,
timelines and delivery roles.
o Define what AISTS can credibly own directly versus what requires technical, legal,
engineering or standards partners.
o Establish quality assurance principles, methodology governance and documentation
standards to protect AISTS credibility.
• Explore opportunities of application of existing products into other fields such as sport venues
and infrastructures, innovation with new materials, compliance with emerging standards and
certification, etc.
Commercial packaging and performance, governance and continuous improvement
• Work with the B2B Development & Marketing team to:
o identify priority clients and opportunities, including IFs, event organisers, brands, technology
providers and venues.
o translate technical products into simple commercial materials, one-pagers, case studies and
pitch narratives.
• Create product pricing and effort models that improve profitability compared with bespoke oneoff
projects
• Track project outcomes, client satisfaction, methodology improvements, cost of delivery and
repeatability.
• Build a database of assessments and findings over time to enable benchmarking, recurring
diagnostics and future thought leadership.
What we offer
• Dynamic Work Environment: Join an international team passionate about sports and education.
• Career Development: Gain exposure to a wide range of projects in a prestigious organisation.
• Inclusive Culture: We value diverse perspectives and actively encourage applications from all
genders, backgrounds, and experiences.
• Professional Growth: Access to training programmes to enhance your skills and career
development.
• Mentorship Opportunities: Be part of a supportive team committed to helping you thrive in your
role.
• Prime Location: Work in Lausanne, the Olympic Capital, with access to sports facilities and view on
the lake
Your skills and experience

o 2-3 years of experience, in sport advisory, consulting or research capacity, preferably with
experience in product management;
o Strong ability to bring ideas and methodologies into pragmatic and applicable solutions
o Business mindset, with ability to frame value propositions and pricing in line with AISTS quality
and mission
o Strong understanding of Olympic and international sport ecosystem, in particular of trends
and challenges of the sport industry;

title: SOFTWARE SOLUTION ENGINEER
description:
Securecell is a Swiss technology company at the intersection of biotechnology, engineering, and healthcare. For more than three decades, we have been developing innovative solutions that help advance scientific discoveries and improve people's lives. Combining deep expertise in bioprocess control with a strong culture of innovation, we collaborate across disciplines to transform complex challenges into practical technologies that create real-world impact.

Continuing steadily on our sustainable innovation path and growth journey, we are looking for a
SOFTWARE SOLUTION ENGINEER
for our Information Technology Department – Software Architecture team – product R&D role

THE OPPORTUNITY
It is an opportunity to contribute to technologies that support groundbreaking scientific discoveries and help shape the future of biotechnology and healthcare.
As a member of our Software Architecture team, you will play an important role in designing, developing, verifying, and managing the lifecycle of software solutions for innovative medical and biotechnological devices. Working closely with experts from various disciplines, you will contribute to challenging projects, develop innovative solutions, and help deliver products that create value for our customers worldwide.
Whether you are improving existing technologies, driving innovation, or solving complex technical challenges, your contributions will have a direct impact on our success and future growth.
You are part of our Software Architecture Team and accountable for the design, development, verification, and lifecycle management of our Lucullus software platform. In this role, you actively contribute to software development, provide technical leadership, and oversee the software development, integration, and verification of our innovative devices. Lucullus is our process information management platform for bioprocess labs: it connects and controls lab devices and bioreactors, acquires and stores process data, and supports experiment planning and analysis.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
•    Design and evolve the architecture of the Lucullus platform (modules, APIs, data model, device-integration layer) and document key decisions in architecture decision records and design specifications.
•    Implement key components yourself (approx. 50% of time is hands-on design and coding)
•    Own the non-functional requirements: performance, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.
•    Prototype and evaluate new technologies before they are adopted in the product.
•    Create, review, and maintain technical documentation, including specifications and design descriptions.
•    Support requirements management, risk management, and compliance activities in accordance with applicable standards and quality requirements.
•    Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, and Product Management.

WHO YOU ARE
You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and thrive in an environment where software architecture and development are critical to delivering innovative technologies. You are proactive, hands-on, and motivated to develop technologies that advance biotechnology and improve lives. You are comfortable providing technical leadership within cross-functional and agile teams. You would rather design and build than coordinate: you enjoy writing code, sketching architecture, and defending technical trade-offs with facts. Leading here means leading by technical example, not by managing people or schedules.


YOUR PROFILE
•    Completed studies (FH / Uni / ETH) in Engineering, preferably Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology.
•    At least 3years of experience in software development.
•    Strong expertise in software development with experience in enterprise-grade applications. Hands-on approach.
•    Ability to collaborate effectively, translating architectural decisions into technical solutions across teams.
•    Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complexity in a large technical stack.
•    Ability to mentor engineers and drive technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews.
•    Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD tools, and automation frameworks.
•    Proficiency in Linux environments, particularly with LTS distributions and Oracle Linux (preferred but open to alternatives).
•    Industry experience in Medtech/Biotech and in (bio)process technology is not a prerequisite; however, there must be a strong interest and awareness that the environment is regulated.
•    Experience working with enterprise databases, particularly Oracle DB and PostgreSQL.
•    Solid understanding of security best practices, compliance, and secure coding methodologies.
•    A valid work permit is required, and only direct applications will be taken into consideration (no agencies)

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL
•    Experience in biotechnology, bioprocessing, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, or life sciences (nice to have)
•    Proven track record of designing and personally implementing software systems end-to-end
•    Passion for innovation and technology
•    Ability to navigate ambiguity and identify practical solutions
•    Strong sense of ownership and accountability
•    Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset
•    Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across disciplines
•    Experience working in multidisciplinary and international environments

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT SECURECELL
Make an Impact: Your work contributes to innovative technologies that support scientific progress, improve healthcare outcomes, and help address real-world challenges
Work with Exceptional People: Join a global team of talented scientists, engineers, software developers, and business professionals who are passionate about innovation and collaboration
Grow Your Career: We encourage continuous learning and provide opportunities to develop new skills, expand your expertise, and take on new challenges
Innovate Every Day: Be part of cutting-edge projects and help develop solutions that push the boundaries of biotechnology, automation, and healthcare technology
Take Ownership: We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. You'll enjoy a high level of responsibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to make a visible contribution
Enjoy a Collaborative Culture: Our success is built on teamwork, knowledge sharing, mutual respect, and a genuine passion for solving complex challenges together
Be Part of Our Growth Story: Join a growing Swiss technology company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and long-term thinking are at the core of everything we do

WHAT WE OFFER
With flexible working arrangements, a modern workplace, flat hierarchies, and short decision-making paths, we empower individuals to take ownership, contribute ideas, and make a visible impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement, allowing every team member to help shape the future of our company and the industries we serve. To complement this, we offer:
•    Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and contribution
•    Comprehensive benefits package supporting your well-being
•    Generous vacation entitlement, flexible working hours, and hybrid or remote work options
•    Flexible leave arrangements that support work-life balance
•    Learning and development opportunities through training, mentoring, and hands-on experiences
•    Opportunities to collaborate with international customers and partners
•    Convenient location with direct access to public transport, free indoor parking, complimentary coffee and mineral water
•    Private accident insurance and paid time off for new parents
•    Employee share purchase programs (availability varies upon eligibility)
•    Regular team events and company gatherings that strengthen connections and celebrate success

JOB LOCATION
This position is based at Securecell AG headquarters in Urdorf (Zurich), Switzerland. Reporting to: Head of Software.

INTERESTED?
We look forward to learning more about you! Please submit your complete application, including a cover letter, a resume, certificates, and references, through our career portal at www.securecell.ch/jobs, and share, in 2-3 sentences, what attracted you to our company and this role.

title: Head of Physical Education and Sport Faculty
description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Head of Physical Education and Sport Faculty
to join the school from: August 2027

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 02.11.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE

Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for around 500 students aged 7-18 representing 70 nations. Students prepare for IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme.

The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced, enthusiastic, dynamic, knowledgeable leader and/or teacher of Physical Education and Sport. PE and Sport are compulsory for students throughout the Junior and Senior schools. In Years 10 and 11 students have the option of studying IGCSE PE. Subsequently, in Years 12 and 13, Sports, Exercise and Health Science is offered and is currently taught in conjunction with the Science department.
KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Professional Standards and Expectations
Carry out teaching duties and exercise responsibilities in line with the Guiding Principles of Aiglon;
Treat all members of the community, colleagues and students, with respect and consideration. Treat all students fairly, consistently and without prejudice;
Set a good example to students in terms of appropriate dress, standards of punctuality and attendance;
Read and adhere to the various policies of the school as expressed in the Aiglon Guide and other agreed documentation, and support the ethos of the school by upholding the behaviour code, uniform and kit regulations and other expectations;
Be available to work on campus in good time to complete all necessary preparations and meetings before the start of term;
Take personal responsibility for professional development and participate in staff training in line with the continued professional development programme of Aiglon;
Encourage members of their faculty to take responsibility for their own professional development and ensure all in the faculty participate in staff training in line with the CPD programme of Aiglon;
Reflect on personal and school practices in pursuit of continuous improvement.
Participate in appraisal and self-evaluation activities and ensure the appraisal system is adhered to and completed within the faculty;
Chair a weekly faculty meeting;
Ensure all faculty members are aware of and adhere to departmental deadlines, policies and procedures;
Undertake pastoral and other duties, including weekend and evening duties, as prescribed within school policies;
Ensure that all deadlines are met as published in the school calendar and as directed by the Head of Faculty/Deputy School Directors;
Undertake professional duties that may be reasonably assigned, including cover and exam invigilation and ensure members of their faculty also undertake these duties;
Attend Assembly/Meditation on at least two mornings a week when averaged over any term and be prepared to give a Meditation once each year;
Be proactive and take responsibility for matters relating to health and safety;
Support the school through regular attendance at various events in the School Calendar (these may be religious, spiritual, sporting or cultural).
Departmental Management
Implement a clear vision for curriculum Physical Education and all aspects of Sport at Aiglon, making sure that there is continuity and progression between Junior School and Senior School;
Develop and manage the strategic development plan for the faculty in line with the School’s strategic development plan thus fostering a love of Physical Education and inspiring a lifelong commitment to Sport;
Line management of Head of Junior Physical Education and Sport, Head of Senior Physical Education and Sport, Head of Snowsports and Performance Athletes, MCFC football coach and the Sports Facilities Manager and support  them in the management of all other members of the Physical Education and Sport faculty;
Ensure that the faculty embraces the opportunities available through strategic partnerships including MCFC;
Ensure the faculty handbook is updated annually and includes reference to objectives for the year ahead which tie into the school’s overall objectives;
Provide a strategic link between the Academic Leadership Group and the Physical Education and Sport faculty, attending meetings and reporting on School-wide initiatives;
Ensure that the Department meets the curriculum requirements for the School;
Monitor and develop the quality of teaching, coaching and learning, through regular visits to lessons and otherwise, with a clear focus on excellence;
Implement a clear vision and structure for competitive inter-school sport across the School at Aiglon;
Implement a clear programme for inter-house sport at Aiglon. Liaise with the Director of Boarding and attend House Parent meetings where necessary to publicise and promote sporting initiatives, with clear communication to all stakeholders (students, staff and parents);
Promote and communicate to the Aiglon community initiatives and success stories from the Physical Education and Sport faculty, through weekly assemblies and the calendar alongside regular liaison with stakeholders in Admissions, Communications and Alumni teams;
Ensure that requirements of examination boards are met, and students are entered for public examinations, submitting appropriate coursework and ensuring that students are suitably prepared for examinations;
Preparing an annual report for the Deputy Director setting out an analysis of external examination results and value-added statistics;
Ensure, in consultation with the Deputy School Director the effective deployment of staff and classes within the Department;
Participate in the appointment of new staff, and support new staff entering the Department;
Ensure all members of the faculty take account of students' prior levels of attainment, and baseline data where relevant, and use these to set targets for future improvements;
Oversee all aspects of the organisation of tournaments, fixtures and trips where appropriate;
To be available for School sporting events including The Challenge, Sports Day and other major School events;
Booking of snowsports instructors for all students in the winter term, which will require close liaison with external ski school instructors used by Aiglon, ensuring a high level of instruction takes place and to ensure ability groups are monitored regularly.

Sport Advisory Product Coordinator
==================================

Are you passionate about challenging the status\-quo in sport?

Do you value research\-driven and scientifically rigourous solutions?

Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?  
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?  

Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping the future of sports leadership.

About AISTS
-----------

AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not\-for\-profit academic centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it offers world\-class education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary approach combines expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership. With a network of over 750 alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport organisations, AISTS shapes the future of international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting excellence in sport management to drive positive global impact through the power of sport.

Your role
---------

The Product Coordinator – Sport Advisroy is responsible for building AISTS sport advisory – such as impact assessment, sport equipment certification, etc. – into clear, market\-facing products with scientifically\-rigorous methodologies and lean delivery models. The role covers two main product families: impact assessments and analysis for sport events and organisations; and sport equipment compliance/certification services for key sport equipment stakeholders (rule\-makers, designers, producers, users…).

Positioning \& Context
----------------------

Reporting into the Product Portfolio Senior Manager, you will work in partnership with the Professors and researchers of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the B2B Development \& Marketing team and the Operations \& Delivery team.

This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role may evolve according to the deployment of the strategy.

Key responsibilities
--------------------

**Product development**

* Transform AISTS globally recognised assessment methodologies into clear, repeatable and cost\-efficient products while preserving its core characteristics: scientifically rigorous and pragmatic for industry application, incl.:


\-\> standardised impact assessment products with economic impact as a core entry point and extensions into environmental, social \& media and stakeholder/community\-relevant impacts

\-\> independent sport equipment regulation assessment and certification processes to support key sport stakeholders – federations, event organisers, manufacturers and athletes – in guaranteeing a level\-playing field companies in designing, assessing and certifying processes, operational frameworks and quality standards.

\-\> Develop sample outputs, case references and marketing\-ready value propositions for IFs, event organisers, cities, hosts, sponsors and sport organisations.

* Create a leaner operational model that combines AISTS quality assurance with external experts, academic partners and delivery coordinators where appropriate:


\-\> Define product formats, methodology templates, data needs, deliverables, pricing logic, timelines and delivery roles.

\-\> Define what AISTS can credibly own directly versus what requires technical, legal, engineering or standards partners.

\-\> Establish quality assurance principles, methodology governance and documentation standards to protect AISTS credibility.

* Explore opportunities of application of existing products into other fields such as sport venues and infrastructures, innovation with new materials, compliance with emerging standards and certification, etc.


**Commercial packaging and performance, governance and continuous improvement**

* Work with the B2B Development \& Marketing team to:


\-\> identify priority clients and opportunities, including IFs, event organisers, brands, technology providers and venues.

\-\> translate technical products into simple commercial materials, one\-pagers, case studies and pitch narratives.

* Create product pricing and effort models that improve profitability compared with bespoke one\-off projects
* Track project outcomes, client satisfaction, methodology improvements, cost of delivery and repeatability.
* Build a database of assessments and findings over time to enable benchmarking, recurring diagnostics and future thought leadership.


What we offer
-------------

**Dynamic Work Environment:** Join an international team passionate about sports and education.

**Career Development:** Gain exposure to a wide range of projects in a prestigious organisation.

**Inclusive Culture:** We value diverse perspectives and actively encourage applications from all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.

**Professional Growth:** Access to training programmes to enhance your skills and career development.

**Mentorship Opportunities:** Be part of a supportive team committed to helping you thrive in your role.

**Prime Location:** Work in Lausanne, the Olympic Capital, with access to sports facilities and view on the lake

Your skills and experience
--------------------------

**Experience:**

* 2\-3 years of experience, in sport advisory, consulting or research capacity, preferably with experience in product management;
* Strong ability to bring ideas and methodologies into pragmatic and applicable solutions
* Business mindset, with ability to frame value propositions and pricing in line with AISTS quality and mission
* Strong understanding of Olympic and international sport ecosystem, in particular of trends and challenges of the sport industry;
* Relevant network in the sport industry and international sport organisations a strong asset;
* Familiarity with Swiss higher education environment an asset;


**Technical Skills:**

* Proficiency in MS Office 365; experience AI solutions, data management and CRM an asset;
* Business engineering or engineering background;
* Native\-level fluency in English or French, with proficiency in the other language (3rd language is a plus).
* Familiarity with AISTS activities and the MAS programme is highly valued;
* Experience related to sport (athlete, volunteer, coach or management) is highly valued;


**Personal Traits:** Agile, flexible with ability to adapt in all situation, reliable, highly organised and at ease with multitasking and service\-oriented with strong communication skills in multicultural environments

**Education:** Master (MSc) degree in (Sport) Management and Business, Applied Sciences or Engineering with a keen interest for sport.

What we expect
--------------

* Results driven, ability to sense priorities and client / service oriented.
* Dynamic personality with strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to maintain a positive, pragmatic and open\-minded attitude under stressful and operational situations.
* Strong organisational, analytical, project and time management skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Diplomacy, tact and discretion. Keen sense of confidentiality.
* Flexibility to work occasionally in the evenings and on weekends.


We welcome candidates from all professional backgrounds and encourage applications even if not all qualifications are met. At AISTS, we value your potential.

How to Apply
------------

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage applications from women and men equally. We particularly welcome candidates who bring diverse experiences and perspectives.

Send your CV, work certificates, and a cover letter (in English) outlining your motivation to join AISTS only. Deadline of application 11th of October 2026\.

**Starting Date:** As soon as possible

**Occupancy rate:** full time, 100%

**Location of work:** Lausanne, Switzerland

Make an impact on the development of international sport. Apply today!
